<script>
/* ============================================================
   Pluto — Messenger (single-file web app)
   Cloud mode (Firebase: accounts, chats, E2EE) + local mode.
   Real 1:1 audio/video calls over WebRTC.  build v75
   ============================================================ */
const COLORS = ['#0d7d74','#e07a5f','#3d6bb3','#8e5bb5','#c0504d','#2a9d8f','#b5651d','#4a6fa5','#a14e7a','#437c90'];
const AV = n => { let h=0; for(const c of n) h=(h*31+c.charCodeAt(0))>>>0; return COLORS[h%COLORS.length]; };
const INI = n => n.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0,2).map(w=>w[0]).join('').toUpperCase();
const now = () => Date.now();
const fmt = ts => new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString('en-IN',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:true});
function dayKeyOf(ts){ const d=new Date(ts||Date.now()); return d.getFullYear()+'-'+d.getMonth()+'-'+d.getDate(); }
function dayLabelOf(ts){
  const d=new Date(ts||Date.now()); const t=new Date(); const y=new Date(Date.now()-86400000);
  const same=(a,b)=>a.getFullYear()===b.getFullYear()&&a.getMonth()===b.getMonth()&&a.getDate()===b.getDate();
  if(same(d,t)) return 'Today';
  if(same(d,y)) return 'Yesterday';
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'});
}

/* ---------- Local password hashing (never store the password itself) ---------- */
async function hashPass(pw, salt){
  try{
    const data = new TextEncoder().encode('pluto:'+salt+':'+pw);
    const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
    return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
  }catch(e){ return null; }
}
function randSalt(){
  const a = new Uint8Array(16);
  if(window.crypto && crypto.getRandomValues) crypto.getRandomValues(a);
  else for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++) a[i]=Math.floor(Math.random()*256);
  return Array.from(a).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}

const TICK_SVG = (cls) =>
  `<svg class="tick ${cls}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m1 13 4 4L13 7"/><path d="m9 13 4 4L22 6"/></svg>`;
const TICK1_SVG = (cls) =>
  `<svg class="tick ${cls}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m5 13 5 5L20 6"/></svg>`;

/* ---------- Seed data ---------- */
function seed(){
  return [];
}
const CONTACTS = [];

const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = { theme:'auto', wallpaper:'default', readReceipts:true, notifMessages:true, notifGroups:true, notifCalls:true, ringtone:true, lastSeen:true, profilePhoto:true };
function seedStories(){
  return [];
}
function seedCalls(){
  return [];
}
let state = load();
function load(){
  try{
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('pluto_state');
    if(raw){ const s = JSON.parse(raw); if(!('user' in s)) s.user = null; s.settings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, s.settings||{}); if(!s.blocked) s.blocked = []; if(!s.stories) s.stories = seedStories(); if(!s.calls) s.calls = seedCalls(); if(!s.presence) s.presence = {}; return s; }
  }catch(e){}
  return { chats: seed(), stories: seedStories(), calls: seedCalls(), presence:{}, tab:'chats', user:null, blocked:[], settings: Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS), profile:{ name:'You', about:'Available' } };
}
function save(){ try{ localStorage.setItem('pluto_state', JSON.stringify(state)); }catch(e){ if(!save._warned){ save._warned=true; try{ toast('Storage full — new items will not be saved'); }catch(_){} } } }

/* ---------- Elements ---------- */
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const mainScroll = $('#mainScroll');
const messagesEl = $('#messages');
const msgInput = $('#msgInput');
let activeChatId = null;
let lastSend = '—';

/* ---------- Render main list by tab ---------- */
function renderMain(){
  const tab = state.tab;
  const q = ($('#searchInput').value||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  let html = '';
  const _unread = state.chats.reduce((s,c)=>s+(c.unread||0),0);
  const _cb = $('#chatsBadge');
  if(_cb){ _cb.textContent = _unread; _cb.style.display = _unread ? 'grid' : 'none'; }
  if(tab==='chats'){
    let list = state.chats.filter(c=>!c.archived);
    if(q) list = list.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    list.sort((a,b)=> (b.pinned?1:0)-(a.pinned?1:0) || lastTsOf(b)-lastTsOf(a));
    if(!list.length){ html = emptyHTML('No chats found','chat'); }
    else {
      html = list.map(chatRow).join('') + '<div style="height:96px"></div>';
    }
  }
  else if(tab==='calls'){
    const list = state.calls || [];
    if(!list.length){ html = emptyHTML('No calls. Tap + to make a new call.','call'); }
    else html = list.map(k=>{
      const arrow = k.dir==='out' ? '<path d="M7 17 17 7M9 7h8v8"/>' : '<path d="M17 7 7 17M15 17H7V9"/>';
      const cls = k.dir==='miss' ? 'miss' : (k.dir==='in'?'in':'');
      const label = k.dir==='miss' ? 'Missed' : (k.dir==='in'?'Incoming':'Outgoing');
      const meta = k.dur>0 ? fmtDur(k.dur) : (k.dir==='miss'?'':'No answer');
      const metaLine = [label, meta, callWhen(k.ts)].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      return `<div class="list-row" data-callrow="${k.id}">
        <div class="avatar" style="background:${AV(k.name)}">${INI(k.name)}</div>
        <div class="t">
          <div class="a">${esc(k.name)}${k.video?' 🎥':''}</div>
          <div class="b ${cls}"><svg class="arr" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${arrow}</svg>${metaLine}</div>
        </div>
        <button class="icon-btn" style="background:var(--brand-tint);color:var(--brand)" data-call="${esc(k.name)}" data-video="${k.video?1:0}">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M22 16.9v3a2 2 0 0 1-2.2 2 19.8 19.8 0 0 1-8.6-3 19.5 19.5 0 0 1-6-6A19.8 19.8 0 0 1 2.1 4.2 2 2 0 0 1 4.1 2h3a2 2 0 0 1 2 1.7c.1 1 .4 1.9.7 2.8a2 2 0 0 1-.5 2.1L8.1 9.9a16 16 0 0 0 6 6l1.3-1.3a2 2 0 0 1 2.1-.4c.9.3 1.8.6 2.8.7a2 2 0 0 1 1.7 2Z"/></svg>
        </button>
      </div>`;
    }).join('') + '<div style="height:96px"></div>';
  }
  else if(tab==='stories'){
    const mine = state.stories.find(s=>s.mine);
    const others = state.stories.filter(s=>!s.mine);
    const mineHas = mine && mine.items.length;
    html = `<div class="stories-row">
      <div class="story" data-story-id="${mineHas?mine.id:'me'}">
        ${ mineHas
          ? `<div class="ring"><div class="avatar" style="background:var(--brand)">${INI(mine.name)}</div></div>`
          : `<div class="ring seen"><div class="avatar" style="background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--brand);font-size:24px">+</div></div>` }
        <div class="lbl">My story</div>
      </div>
      ${others.map(s=>`
        <div class="story" data-story-id="${s.id}">
          <div class="ring ${s.seen?'seen':''}"><div class="avatar" style="background:${AV(s.name)}">${INI(s.name)}</div></div>
          <div class="lbl">${esc(s.name.split(' ')[0])}</div>
        </div>`).join('')}
    </div>
    <div class="section-label">Recent updates</div>
    ${ others.length
      ? others.map(s=>`
        <div class="list-row" data-story-id="${s.id}">
          <div class="avatar" style="background:${AV(s.name)}">${INI(s.name)}</div>
          <div class="t"><div class="a">${esc(s.name)}</div><div class="b">${ago(s.items[s.items.length-1].ts)} · ${s.seen?'Seen':'New'}</div></div>
        </div>`).join('')
      : `<div class="set-note">No update yet. Tap "My story" to add your story.</div>` }`;
  }
  else if(tab==='settings'){
    const u = state.user || state.profile;
    html = `
      <div class="settings-head">
        <div class="avatar" style="background:${AV(u.name)}">${INI(u.name)}</div>
        <div class="nm">${u.name}</div>
        <div class="ph">${[u.email,u.mobile].filter(Boolean).map(esc).join(' · ') || 'Available'}</div>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="editProfileBtn" style="width:auto;padding:9px 18px;margin-top:6px">Edit profile</button>
      </div>
      ${settingRow('user','Profile','Name, about, photo','profile')}
      ${settingRow('bell','Notifications','Messages, groups, calls','notifications')}
      ${settingRow('lock','Privacy','Blocked contacts, last seen','privacy')}
      ${settingRow('chat','Chat settings','Wallpaper, backup, storage','chats')}
      ${settingRow('shield','Security','End-to-end encryption','security')}
      ${settingRow('cloud','Backend (Firebase)','Real accounts (signup / login)','backend')}
      <div class="setting-row" data-open-privacy>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10Z"/><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/></svg></div>
        <div class="tx"><div class="a">Privacy policy</div><div class="b">How your data is handled</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="setting-row" data-open-perms>
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 12l2 2 4-4"/><path d="M12 3a9 9 0 1 0 9 9"/></svg></div>
        <div class="tx"><div class="a">Permissions</div><div class="b">Location, camera, mic, files</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="setting-row">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8Z"/></svg></div>
        <div class="tx"><div class="a">Theme</div><div class="b">Appearance</div></div>
        <div class="seg" id="themeSeg">
          <button data-theme-opt="auto" class="${state.settings.theme==='auto'?'on':''}">Auto</button>
          <button data-theme-opt="light" class="${state.settings.theme==='light'?'on':''}">Light</button>
          <button data-theme-opt="dark" class="${state.settings.theme==='dark'?'on':''}">Dark</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="setting-row" data-skey="readReceipts">
        <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m1 13 4 4L13 7"/><path d="m9 13 4 4L22 6"/></svg></div>
        <div class="tx"><div class="a">Read receipts</div><div class="b">Blue ticks</div></div>
        <div class="switch ${state.settings.readReceipts?'on':''}" data-switch="readReceipts"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="list-row" style="justify-content:center;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:12px;border:none;padding:16px 12px 0;text-align:center">Pluto · ${APP_VERSION}</div>
      <div class="profile-actions">
        <button class="btn btn-danger" id="logoutBtn">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 21H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4"/><path d="M16 17l5-5-5-5M21 12H9"/></svg>
          Logout
        </button>
      </div>
      `;
  }
  mainScroll.innerHTML = html;
}
function emptyHTML(msg, kind){
  return `<div class="empty">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 11.5a8.4 8.4 0 0 1-9 8.4 9.7 9.7 0 0 1-3-.4L3 21l1.6-4.8A8.3 8.3 0 0 1 3 11.5 8.4 8.4 0 0 1 12 3a8.4 8.4 0 0 1 9 8.5Z"/></svg>
    <p>${msg}</p></div>`;
}
function settingRow(icon, title, sub, key){
  const paths = {
    user:'<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0"/>',
    bell:'<path d="M18 8a6 6 0 1 0-12 0c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"/><path d="M13.7 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.4 0"/>',
    lock:'<rect x="4" y="11" width="16" height="10" rx="2"/><path d="M8 11V8a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3"/>',
    chat:'<path d="M21 11.5a8.4 8.4 0 0 1-9 8.4 9.7 9.7 0 0 1-3-.4L3 21l1.6-4.8A8.3 8.3 0 0 1 3 11.5 8.4 8.4 0 0 1 12 3a8.4 8.4 0 0 1 9 8.5Z"/>',
    shield:'<path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10Z"/>',
    cloud:'<path d="M17.5 19a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 0-9 6 6 0 0 0-11.6 1.5A3.5 3.5 0 0 0 6.5 19Z"/>'
  };
  return `<div class="setting-row"${key?` data-setting="${key}"`:''}>
    <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${paths[icon]}</svg></div>
    <div class="tx"><div class="a">${title}</div><div class="b">${sub}</div></div>
    <div class="chev"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6"/></svg></div>
  </div>`;
}
function chatRow(c){
  const last = c.msgs[c.msgs.length-1] || (c.lastMsg ? {text:c.lastMsg.text, ts:c.lastMsg.ts, from:(c.lastMsg.from===fb.uid?'me':'them')} : {text:'',ts:now(),from:'them'});
  let preview = last.kind==='location' ? (last.live?'📍 Live location':'📍 Location')
    : last.kind==='image' ? '📷 Photo'
    : last.kind==='video' ? '🎥 Video'
    : last.kind==='file' ? '📄 '+(last.name||'Document')
    : last.kind==='voice' ? '🎤 Voice message'
    : last.text;
  let tick = '';
  if(last.from==='me') tick = tickHTML(last);
  const unread = c.unread>0 ? `<span class="badge">${c.unread}</span>` : '';
  return `<div class="chat-item" data-chat="${c.id}">
    <div class="avatar" style="background:${AV(c.name)}">${INI(c.name)}${peerIsOnline(c)?'<span class="dot"></span>':''}</div>
    <div class="chat-main">
      <div class="chat-top">
        ${c.pinned?'<svg class="pin-ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 17v5M9 3h6l-1 6 3 3H7l3-3-1-6Z"/></svg>':''}
        <span class="chat-name">${c.name}</span>
        <span class="chat-time">${fmt(last.ts)}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="chat-preview">${tick}<span style="overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">${preview}</span></div>
    </div>
    ${unread}
  </div>`;
}

/* ---------- Chat view ---------- */
function openChat(id){
  activeChatId = id;
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!c) return;
  c.unread = 0; c._seenTs = Date.now(); save();
  $('#chatName').textContent = c.name;
  const av = $('#chatAvatar');
  av.textContent = INI(c.name); av.style.background = AV(c.name);
  const oldDot = av.querySelector('.dot'); if(oldDot) oldDot.remove();
  if(c.cloud){
    if(peerIsOnline(c)){ const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='dot'; av.appendChild(d); }
    $('#chatStatus').textContent = peerStatusText(c);
    updateChatLock(c);
    startCloudMsgs(c);
  } else {
    if(!c.isGroup && isOnline(c.name)){ const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='dot'; av.appendChild(d); }
    $('#chatStatus').textContent = c.isGroup ? ((c.members?c.members.length:0)+' members') : statusText(c.name);
  }
  renderMessages(true);
  updateLiveBar();
  renderMain();
  $('#mainView').classList.add('slide-out');
  const cv = $('#chatView');
  cv.classList.remove('hidden');
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ cv.classList.add('slide-in'); renderMiniMaps(); messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight; });
  setTimeout(()=>{ messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight; }, 80);
}
function closeChat(){
  $('#chatView').classList.add('hidden');
  $('#mainView').classList.remove('slide-out');
  toggleAttachMenu(false);
  toggleEmojiPanel(false);
  $('#liveBar').classList.remove('show');
  closeMap();
  closeCamera();
  hideRecBar();
  stopCloudMsgs();
  activeChatId = null;
}
let _lastMsgSig = '';
function renderMessages(_forceBottom){
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  if(!c){ messagesEl.innerHTML=''; _lastMsgSig=''; return; }
  const _sig = c.id+'#'+c.msgs.map(m=>m.id+':'+(m.from==='me'?(m.status||''):'')+':'+((m.text||'').length)+':'+(m.kind||'')+':'+(m.live?1:0)+':'+(m.starred?1:0)+':'+(m.forwarded?1:0)+':'+(m.uploading?('u'+m.progress):'')).join('|')+':'+selIds.join(',');
  if(!_forceBottom && _sig===_lastMsgSig) return;
  _lastMsgSig=_sig;
  let html = '';
  let _lastDay = null;
  for(const m of c.msgs){
    const _dk = dayKeyOf(m.ts);
    if(_dk !== _lastDay){ _lastDay = _dk; html += `<div class="day-sep">${dayLabelOf(m.ts)}</div>`; }
    const out = m.from==='me';
    let tick='';
    if(out) tick = tickHTML(m);
    const body = msgBody(m, out);
    html += `<div class="msg ${out?'out':'in'} ${m.kind==='location'?'loc':''} ${(m.kind && m.kind!=='location')?'media':''}${m.starred?' starred':''}${selIds.indexOf(String(m.id))>=0?' selected':''}" data-msg="${m.id}">
      ${selIds.indexOf(String(m.id))>=0?'<div class="sel-check">✓</div>':''}
      ${(!out && m.sender)?`<div class="sender">${m.sender}</div>`:''}
      ${m.forwarded?`<div class="fwd-tag">↪ Forwarded</div>`:''}
      ${body}
      <div class="meta"><span class="time">${fmt(m.ts)}</span>${tick}</div>
    </div>`;
  }
  const _stick = _forceBottom || (messagesEl.scrollHeight - messagesEl.scrollTop - messagesEl.clientHeight) < 120;
  const _prevTop = messagesEl.scrollTop;
  messagesEl.innerHTML = html;
  messagesEl.querySelectorAll('audio[data-audio]').forEach(a=>{
    a.addEventListener('ended', ()=>{ const b=document.querySelector(`[data-play="${a.dataset.audio}"]`); if(b) b.textContent='▶'; });
  });
  renderMiniMaps();
  messagesEl.scrollTop = _stick ? messagesEl.scrollHeight : _prevTop;
}
function haversine(a,b){
  const R=6371000, t=x=>x*Math.PI/180;
  const dLat=t(b.lat-a.lat), dLng=t(b.lng-a.lng);
  const la1=t(a.lat), la2=t(b.lat);
  const h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2 + Math.cos(la1)*Math.cos(la2)*Math.sin(dLng/2)**2;
  return 2*R*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h));
}
function fmtDist(m){
  if(m<1000) return Math.round(m)+' m';
  return (m/1000).toFixed(m<10000?1:0)+' km';
}
function offsetLL(lat,lng,meters,bearingDeg){
  const R=6371000, br=bearingDeg*Math.PI/180, d=meters/R;
  const la1=lat*Math.PI/180, lo1=lng*Math.PI/180;
  const la2=Math.asin(Math.sin(la1)*Math.cos(d)+Math.cos(la1)*Math.sin(d)*Math.cos(br));
  const lo2=lo1+Math.atan2(Math.sin(br)*Math.sin(d)*Math.cos(la1), Math.cos(d)-Math.sin(la1)*Math.sin(la2));
  return {lat:la2*180/Math.PI, lng:lo2*180/Math.PI};
}
function bearingBetween(a,b){
  const t=x=>x*Math.PI/180;
  const y=Math.sin(t(b.lng-a.lng))*Math.cos(t(b.lat));
  const x=Math.cos(t(a.lat))*Math.sin(t(b.lat))-Math.sin(t(a.lat))*Math.cos(t(b.lat))*Math.cos(t(b.lng-a.lng));
  return (Math.atan2(y,x)*180/Math.PI+360)%360;
}
function etaText(sec){
  if(sec==null || !isFinite(sec)) return '';
  if(sec<60) return Math.round(sec)+' sec';
  const m=Math.round(sec/60);
  return m<60 ? m+' min' : Math.round(m/60)+' hr';
}
function compactTime(exp){
  const ms=exp-now(); if(ms<=0) return '0m';
  const mins=Math.floor(ms/60000);
  if(mins>=60){ const h=Math.floor(mins/60), mm=mins%60; return h+'h'+(mm?mm+'m':''); }
  if(mins>=1) return mins+'m';
  return Math.max(1,Math.floor(ms/1000))+'s';
}
function angDiff(a,b){ return ((a-b+540)%360)-180; }
function sparkSVG(hist){
  if(!hist || hist.length<2) return '<div class="spark-empty">Collecting distance history…</div>';
  const w=212, h=42, pad=4, ds=hist;
  const min=Math.min(...ds), max=Math.max(...ds), range=Math.max(1,max-min), n=ds.length;
  const pts=ds.map((d,i)=>[pad+(i/(n-1))*(w-2*pad), pad+(1-(d-min)/range)*(h-2*pad)]);
  const line=pts.map(p=>p[0].toFixed(1)+','+p[1].toFixed(1)).join(' ');
  const area=`${pad},${h-pad} ${line} ${w-pad},${h-pad}`;
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" preserveAspectRatio="none" class="spark"><polyline class="spark-area" points="${area}"/><polyline class="spark-line" points="${line}"/></svg>`;
}
function chartHTML(m){
  const hist=m.hist||[];
  let cap='<div class="cap"><span>Distance history</span><span>collecting…</span></div>';
  if(hist.length>=2){
    const diff=hist[hist.length-1]-hist[0];
    cap=`<div class="cap"><span>Distance history</span><span>${diff<0?'▼ ':'▲ '}${fmtDist(Math.abs(diff))} ${diff<0?'less':'more'}</span></div>`;
  }
  return sparkSVG(hist) + cap;
}
function midpointOf(a,b){ return { lat:(Number(a.lat)+Number(b.lat))/2, lng:(Number(a.lng)+Number(b.lng))/2 }; }
function meetHTML(m, other){
  if(!(m && m.me && m.them)) return '';
  const mid=midpointOf(m.me, m.them);
  const dMe=haversine(m.me, mid), dThem=haversine(m.them, mid);
  const gap=Math.abs(dMe-dThem);
  const nm = other || 'Contact';
  const who = (gap<15) ? '<b>Both are about the same</b> distance from the meet point.' : ('<b>'+(dMe>dThem?'You':nm)+'</b> is farther from the meet point — '+(dMe>dThem?nm:'You')+' is closer.');
  return `<div class="lm-row"><span class="pt" style="background:#0d7d74"></span><span class="nm">You</span><span class="co">${fmtDist(dMe)}</span></div>`
       + `<div class="lm-row"><span class="pt" style="background:#2f6bd8"></span><span class="nm">${nm}</span><span class="co">${fmtDist(dThem)}</span></div>`
       + `<div class="lm-hint">📍 Meet point (beech ka rasta) — ${who}</div>`
       + (m.eta ? `<div class="lm-hint">⏱️ About <b>${etaText(m.eta)}</b> to reach ${nm} — at your current speed.</div>` : '');
}
function trendHTML(m){
  let s;
  if(m.trend==='approach') s = `<span class="tr up">↓ Getting closer</span>${m.eta?`<span class="eta">ETA ~${etaText(m.eta)}</span>`:''}`;
  else if(m.trend==='away') s = `<span class="tr down">↑ Moving away</span><span class="tr turn">⚠️ Doori badh rahi hai — koi galat raste par ho sakta hai</span>`;
  else s = `<span class="tr flat">• Same place</span>`;
  if(m.routeAt && (now()-m.routeAt<30000)) s += `<span class="tr turn">🧭 Rasta badla</span>`;
  return s;
}
function locBubble(m, out){
  if(m.live && m.me && m.them){
    const me=m.me, them=m.them;
    const lats=[me.lat,them.lat], lngs=[me.lng,them.lng];
    const pad=0.006;
    const dist=haversine(me,them);
    const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
    const other=esc(c?c.name:'Contact');
    return `<div class="loc-card">
      <div class="loc-map" data-minimap="${m.id}"></div>
      <div class="loc-body">
        <div class="loc-title"><span class="live-dot"></span>Live location · 2 users</div>
        <div class="loc-person"><span class="pt" style="background:#0d7d74"></span><span class="nm">You</span><span class="co" data-me="${m.id}">${me.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${me.lng.toFixed(4)}${m.acc?' · ±'+Math.round(m.acc)+'m':''}</span></div>
        <div class="loc-person"><span class="pt" style="background:#2f6bd8"></span><span class="nm">${other}</span><span class="co">${them.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${them.lng.toFixed(4)}</span></div>
        <div class="loc-dist"><span class="val" data-dist="${m.id}">${fmtDist(dist)}</span><span class="u">apart · distance in meters</span></div>
        <div class="loc-meet" data-meet="${m.id}">${meetHTML(m, other)}</div>
        <div class="loc-trend" data-trend="${m.id}">${trendHTML(m)}</div>
        <div class="loc-chart" data-chart="${m.id}">${chartHTML(m)}</div>
        <div class="loc-sub" style="margin-top:6px"><span data-exp="${m.expiresAt}">${timeLeft(m.expiresAt)} left</span> · updated live</div>
        <div class="loc-actions">
          <button class="mini" data-openmap="${m.id}">View map</button>
          ${out?`<button class="mini stop" data-stop="${m.id}">Stop</button>`:''}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(Number(m.lat)) || !Number.isFinite(Number(m.lng))){
    return `<div class="loc-card"><div class="loc-body"><div class="loc-title">${m.live?'<span class="live-dot"></span>Live location':'Location'}</div><div class="loc-sub">🔒 This location can't be read on this device (it was encrypted on the other device).</div></div></div>`;
  }
  const lat = Number(m.lat).toFixed(5), lng = Number(m.lng).toFixed(5);
  const title = m.live ? `<span class="live-dot"></span>Live location` : 'Location';
  const sub = m.live
    ? `<span data-exp="${m.expiresAt}">${timeLeft(m.expiresAt)} left</span> · ${lat}, ${lng}`
    : `${lat}, ${lng}`;
  const stop = (m.live && out) ? `<button class="loc-stop" data-stop="${m.id}">Stop sharing</button>` : '';
  return `<div class="loc-card">
    <div class="loc-map" data-minimap="${m.id}"></div>
    <div class="loc-body">
      <div class="loc-title">${title}</div>
      <div class="loc-sub">${sub}</div>
      <button class="loc-link" data-openloc="${m.id}" style="border:none;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;padding:0">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 3 4 6v15l5-3 6 3 5-3V3l-5 3-6-3Z"/></svg>
        View map
      </button>
      ${stop}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
function timeLeft(exp){
  const ms = exp - now();
  if(ms<=0) return '0 min';
  const mins = Math.floor(ms/60000);
  if(mins>=60){ const h=Math.floor(mins/60), mm=mins%60; return h+'h'+(mm?' '+mm+'m':''); }
  if(mins>=1) return mins+' min';
  return Math.max(1,Math.floor(ms/1000))+' sec';
}
function esc(s){ return s.replace(/[&<>"]/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[ch])); }

/* ---------- Send ---------- */
function sendMessage(){
  const text = msgInput.value.trim();
  if(!text || !activeChatId){ lastSend = (!text ? 'no text in box' : 'no chat open'); return; }
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  if(!c){ lastSend='chat not found in list'; return; }
  if(c && c.cloud){
    if(!fb.enabled || !fb.uid){ lastSend='not connected'; toast('Not connected to the server — please log in again'); return; }
    lastSend='sending to cloud…'; msgInput.value=''; autoGrow(); cloudSend(c.id, {text}); return;
  }
  lastSend='sent locally';
  const id = now();
  c.msgs.push({id, from:'me', text, ts:id, status:'sent'});
  msgInput.value=''; autoGrow();
  save(); renderMessages(); renderMain();
  // simulate delivery -> read
  setTimeout(()=>{ setStatus(c, id, 'delivered'); renderMessages(); renderMain(); }, 700);
  setTimeout(()=>{ setStatus(c, id, 'read'); renderMessages(); renderMain(); }, 1500);
  // simulate reply
  simulateReply(c);
}
function setStatus(c, id, status){
  const m = c.msgs.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(m) m.status = status; save();
}
function simulateReply(c){
  const replies = ['Yes of course 👍','Okay, let me check','Ok!','Haha 😄','Sent it','Talk tomorrow','Great idea!','👍👍'];
  const showTyping = ()=>{
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className='typing'; t.id='typingIndicator';
    t.innerHTML='<span></span><span></span><span></span>';
    messagesEl.appendChild(t);
    messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight;
  };
  setTimeout(showTyping, 900);
  setTimeout(()=>{
    const el = $('#typingIndicator'); if(el) el.remove();
    const id = now();
    const sender = (c.isGroup && c.members && c.members.length) ? c.members[Math.floor(Math.random()*c.members.length)] : null;
    c.msgs.push({id, from:'them', text: replies[Math.floor(Math.random()*replies.length)], ts:id, sender});
    if(activeChatId!==c.id) c.unread = (c.unread||0)+1;
    save(); renderMessages(); renderMain();
  }, 2400);
}
function autoGrow(){
  msgInput.style.height='auto';
  msgInput.style.height = Math.min(msgInput.scrollHeight, 110) + 'px';
}

/* ---------- New chat ---------- */
function openNewChat(){
  if(fb.enabled){ openCloudNewChat(); return; }
  const used = new Set(state.chats.map(c=>c.name));
  $('#contactList').innerHTML =
    `<div class="section-label">Contacts</div>` +
    (CONTACTS.length ? CONTACTS.map(n=>`
      <div class="chat-item" data-new="${n}">
        <div class="avatar" style="background:${AV(n)}">${INI(n)}</div>
        <div class="chat-main"><div class="chat-top"><span class="chat-name">${n}</span></div>
        <div class="chat-preview">Hey there! I am using Pluto.</div></div>
      </div>`).join('') : `<div class="set-note">No contacts yet.</div>`);
  $('#newChatSheet').style.display='flex';
}
function startChat(name){
  let c = state.chats.find(x=>x.name===name);
  if(!c){
    c = { id:'c'+now(), name, pinned:false, unread:0, msgs:[
      {id:now(), from:'them', text:'Hey there! I am using Pluto.', ts:now()}
    ]};
    state.chats.unshift(c); save();
  }
  $('#newChatSheet').style.display='none';
  openChat(c.id);
}

/* ---------- Toast ---------- */
let toastTimer;
function toast(msg){
  const el = $('#toast');
  el.textContent = msg; el.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'), 1800);
}

/* ---------- Events ---------- */
document.addEventListener('click', e=>{
  if(lpFired){ lpFired=false; return; }
  if(selIds.length){
    const _sm = e.target.closest('.msg[data-msg]');
    if(_sm){ toggleSelect(_sm.dataset.msg); return; }
    if(e.target.closest('#selBar')) return;
  }
  const _mp = e.target.closest('[data-msgpop]');
  if(_mp){ const _pop=document.getElementById('msgPop'); handleMsgPop(_mp.dataset.msgpop, _pop&&_pop._m); return; }
  if(!e.target.closest('#msgPop')) hideMsgPop();
  const _lnk = e.target.closest('a.chat-link');
  if(_lnk){ e.preventDefault(); const _u=_lnk.getAttribute('href'); if(!tryOpenExternal(_u)) showLinkSheet(_u); return; }
  const epCatEl = e.target.closest('[data-epcat]');
  if(epCatEl){ epCat = epCatEl.dataset.epcat; renderEmojiPanel(); return; }
  const epEmoji = e.target.closest('[data-emoji]');
  if(epEmoji){ msgInput.value += epEmoji.dataset.emoji; msgInput.focus(); autoGrow(); return; }
  if(!e.target.closest('#menuPop') && !e.target.closest('#menuBtn')) $('#menuPop').classList.remove('show');
  const menuBtnEl = e.target.closest('[data-menu]');
  if(menuBtnEl){ handleMenu(menuBtnEl.dataset.menu); return; }
  const actBtn = e.target.closest('[data-act]');
  if(actBtn){ const it=actionItems[Number(actBtn.dataset.act)]; if(it && it.fn) it.fn(); return; }
  const omEl = e.target.closest('[data-openmedia]');
  if(omEl){ const _cc=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); const _mm=_cc&&_cc.msgs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(omEl.dataset.openmedia)); if(_mm){ if(_mm.kind==='video') playInlineVideo(_mm, omEl); else openMedia(_mm); } return; }
  const saveEl = e.target.closest('[data-save]');
  if(saveEl){ saveMedia(saveEl.dataset.save, saveEl.dataset.name); return; }
  const starRowEl = e.target.closest('[data-star-chat]');
  if(starRowEl){ $('#starSheet').style.display='none'; openChat(starRowEl.dataset.starChat); return; }
  const fwdEl = e.target.closest('[data-fwd]');
  if(fwdEl){ toggleFwd(fwdEl.dataset.fwd); return; }
  const unarchEl = e.target.closest('[data-unarch]');
  if(unarchEl){ const cc=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===unarchEl.dataset.unarch); if(cc){ cc.archived=false; save(); renderMain(); openArchSheet(); toast('Unarchived'); } return; }
  if(e.target.closest('#logoutBtn')){ doLogout(); return; }
  if(e.target.closest('#editProfileBtn')){ openSettingsSection('profile'); return; }
  if(e.target.closest('[data-open-perms]')){ openPermSheet(); return; }
  if(e.target.closest('[data-open-privacy]')){ openPrivacySheet(); return; }
  const permBtn = e.target.closest('[data-perm]');
  if(permBtn){ requestPerm(permBtn.dataset.perm); return; }
  const playBtn = e.target.closest('[data-play]');
  if(playBtn){ toggleAudio(Number(playBtn.dataset.play)); return; }
  if(e.target.closest('#liveBarStop')){ const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); const m=activeLive(c); if(m) confirmStopLive(m.id); return; }
  const _ol = e.target.closest('[data-openloc]');
  if(_ol){ const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); const m=c&&c.msgs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(_ol.dataset.openloc)); if(m) openMap('single', m); return; }
  const openMapEl = e.target.closest('[data-openmap]');
  if(openMapEl){ openMap('dual'); return; }
  const stopEl = e.target.closest('[data-stop]');
  if(stopEl){ confirmStopLive(Number(stopEl.dataset.stop)); return; }
  const locOpt = e.target.closest('[data-loc]');
  if(locOpt){ shareLocation(locOpt.dataset.loc); return; }
  const attachItem = e.target.closest('[data-attach]');
  if(attachItem){
    const k = attachItem.dataset.attach;
    toggleAttachMenu(false);
    if(k==='location') openLocationSheet();
    else if(k==='photo') $('#filePhoto').click();
    else if(k==='doc') $('#fileDoc').click();
    else if(k==='camera'){ cameraTarget='chat'; openCamera(); }
    else if(k==='voice') startVoice();
    return;
  }
  const chatEl = e.target.closest('[data-chat]');
  if(chatEl){ openChat(chatEl.dataset.chat); return; }
  const newEl = e.target.closest('[data-new]');
  if(newEl){ startChat(newEl.dataset.new); return; }
  const storyEl = e.target.closest('[data-story-id]');
  if(storyEl){ openStory(storyEl.dataset.storyId); return; }
  const callEl = e.target.closest('[data-call]');
  if(callEl){ startCall(callEl.dataset.call, callEl.dataset.video==='1'); return; }
  const cnEl = e.target.closest('[data-callnew]');
  if(cnEl){ $('#callPickSheet').style.display='none'; startCall(cnEl.dataset.callnew, false); return; }
  const tabEl = e.target.closest('.tab');
  if(tabEl){
    state.tab = tabEl.dataset.tab; save();
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.toggle('active', t===tabEl));
    const titles = {chats:['Pluto','secure & private'], calls:['Calls','recent'], stories:['Stories','updates'], settings:['Settings','your account']};
    $('#headerTitle').textContent = titles[state.tab][0];
    $('#headerSub').textContent = titles[state.tab][1];
    $('#fabNew').style.display = (state.tab==='chats'||state.tab==='calls') ? 'grid':'none';
    $('#searchBar').style.display='none';
    renderMain(); mainScroll.scrollTop=0;
    return;
  }
  const themeOpt = e.target.closest('[data-theme-opt]');
  if(themeOpt){ setTheme(themeOpt.dataset.themeOpt); return; }
  const settingOpen = e.target.closest('[data-setting]');
  if(settingOpen){ openSettingsSection(settingOpen.dataset.setting); return; }
  const skeyEl = e.target.closest('[data-skey]');
  if(skeyEl){ toggleSetting(skeyEl.dataset.skey); return; }
});

function showAuthPanel(which){
  $('#authWelcome').style.display = which==='welcome'?'block':'none';
  $('#authLogin').style.display   = which==='login'?'block':'none';
  $('#authSignup').style.display  = which==='signup'?'block':'none';
}
function showAuth(){ $('#authView').classList.remove('hidden'); showAuthPanel('welcome'); }
function hideAuth(){ $('#authView').classList.add('hidden'); }
function authErr(sel,msg){ const e=$(sel); e.textContent=msg; e.classList.add('show'); }
function authClear(sel){ $(sel).classList.remove('show'); }

/* ---------- Firebase (real accounts / backend) ---------- */
let fb = { enabled:false, app:null, auth:null, db:null, storage:null, uid:null };
const DEFAULT_FB_CONFIG = { apiKey:"AIzaSyA0VTjCKUbrVhX9Na89h-F_rB2Hug-s3kI", authDomain:"pluto-web-ced55.firebaseapp.com", projectId:"pluto-web-ced55", storageBucket:"pluto-web-ced55.firebasestorage.app", messagingSenderId:"669641621604", appId:"1:669641621604:web:188651c3542bc2335b5f71" };
const DEFAULT_CLOUDINARY = { cloud:"ex9vuxxu", preset:"plutoweb" };
const APP_VERSION = 'v75';   // shown in Settings above Logout
function getFbConfig(){
  try{
    if(localStorage.getItem('pluto_fb_disabled')==='1') return null;
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pluto_fb_config')||'null') || DEFAULT_FB_CONFIG;
  }catch(e){ return DEFAULT_FB_CONFIG; }
}
function setFbConfig(cfg){
  try{
    if(cfg){ localStorage.setItem('pluto_fb_config', JSON.stringify(cfg)); localStorage.removeItem('pluto_fb_disabled'); }
    else { localStorage.removeItem('pluto_fb_config'); localStorage.setItem('pluto_fb_disabled','1'); }
  }catch(e){}
}
function getCloudinary(){ try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pluto_cloudinary')||'null') || DEFAULT_CLOUDINARY; }catch(e){ return DEFAULT_CLOUDINARY; } }
function setCloudinary(cfg){ try{ if(cfg) localStorage.setItem('pluto_cloudinary', JSON.stringify(cfg)); else localStorage.removeItem('pluto_cloudinary'); }catch(e){} }
const FB_VER='10.12.2';
function fbUrls(file){ return ['https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/firebase@'+FB_VER+'/'+file, 'https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/'+FB_VER+'/'+file]; }
function loadScriptChain(urls){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    let i=0;
    const next=()=>{ if(i>=urls.length){ reject(new Error('load failed')); return; }
      const s=document.createElement('script'); s.src=urls[i++]; s.onload=()=>resolve(); s.onerror=next; document.head.appendChild(s); };
    next();
  });
}
async function bootFirebase(){
  const cfg = getFbConfig();
  if(!cfg || !cfg.apiKey || !cfg.projectId) return false;
  try{
    await loadScriptChain(fbUrls('firebase-app-compat.js'));
    await loadScriptChain(fbUrls('firebase-auth-compat.js'));
    await loadScriptChain(fbUrls('firebase-firestore-compat.js'));
  }catch(e){ return false; }
  try{
    fb.app = (window.firebase && firebase.apps && firebase.apps.length) ? firebase.app() : firebase.initializeApp(cfg);
    fb.auth = firebase.auth(); fb.db = firebase.firestore();
    fb.enabled = true;
  }catch(e){ return false; }
  try{
    await loadScriptChain(fbUrls('firebase-storage-compat.js'));
    fb.storage = firebase.storage();
  }catch(e){ fb.storage = null; }
  return true;
}
function fbErrMsg(e){
  const m = {
    'auth/invalid-email':'Email is not valid.',
    'auth/email-already-in-use':'This email is already registered — please log in.',
    'mobile-in-use':'This mobile number is already registered — please log in.',
    'auth/weak-password':'Password must be at least 6 characters.',
    'auth/user-not-found':'No account found with this email.',
    'auth/wrong-password':'Incorrect password.',
    'auth/invalid-credential':'Incorrect email or password.',
    'auth/network-request-failed':'Internet problem — please try again.',
    'auth/too-many-requests':'Too many attempts — please try again later.',
    'auth/requires-recent-login':'For security, please log out and log in again, then try deleting the account.'
  };
  return m[(e&&e.code)||''] || ('Error: '+((e&&e.message)||'something went wrong'));
}
function setCloudPresence(on){
  if(!fb.enabled || !fb.uid) return;
  try{ fb.db.collection('users').doc(fb.uid).set({ online: !!on, lastSeen: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
}
async function afterCloudAuth(u, name, email, mobile){
  fb.uid = u.uid;
  let prof = { name: name || u.displayName || 'User', mobile: mobile || '', email: email || u.email || '', about:'Available' };
  try{
    const ref = fb.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid);
    const doc = await ref.get();
    if(doc.exists) prof = Object.assign(prof, doc.data());
    else await ref.set(prof, {merge:true});
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    const fix = {};
    if(prof.mobile && !prof.mobileKey) fix.mobileKey = mobileKeyOf(prof.mobile);
    try{ if(prof.mobile && prof.email) await fb.db.collection('mobiles').doc(mobileKeyOf(prof.mobile)).set({email:String(prof.email).toLowerCase(), uid:u.uid}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
    if(prof.name && !prof.nameLower) fix.nameLower = prof.name.toLowerCase();
    if(prof.email && prof.email !== String(prof.email).toLowerCase()) fix.email = String(prof.email).toLowerCase();
    if(Object.keys(fix).length) await fb.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set(fix, {merge:true});
  }catch(e){}
  try{ if(prof.mobile && prof.email) await fb.db.collection('mobiles').doc(mobileKeyOf(prof.mobile)).set({email:String(prof.email).toLowerCase(), uid:u.uid}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
  state.user = { name: prof.name, email: prof.email, mobile: prof.mobile||'', phone:'', about: prof.about||'Available' };
  state.profile = { name: prof.name, about: prof.about||'Available' };
  save(); hideAuth(); setCloudPresence(true);
  try{ await e2eInit(u.uid); }catch(e){}
  try{ startCallListener(); }catch(e){}
  const note = $('#authModeNote'); if(note) note.textContent = 'Cloud mode · your account is saved on Firebase';
  try{ startCloudChats(); }catch(e){}
}
async function cloudSignup(name, mobile, email, pass){
  const mk = mobileKeyOf(mobile);
  // one mobile = one account
  let dup=null; try{ dup = await fb.db.collection('mobiles').doc(mk).get(); }catch(e){}
  if(dup && dup.exists) throw { code:'mobile-in-use' };
  const cred = await fb.auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, pass);
  try{ await cred.user.updateProfile({displayName:name}); }catch(e){}
  try{ await fb.db.collection('users').doc(cred.user.uid).set({name, nameLower:(name||'').toLowerCase(), mobile, mobileKey: mk, email:(email||'').toLowerCase(), about:'Available', createdAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp()}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
  try{ await fb.db.collection('mobiles').doc(mk).set({email:(email||'').toLowerCase(), uid: cred.user.uid}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
  return cred.user;
}
async function doSignup(){
  authClear('#signupErr');
  const name=$('#suName').value.trim(), mobile=$('#suMobile').value.trim(), email=$('#suEmail').value.trim(), pass=$('#suPass').value;
  if(!name) return authErr('#signupErr','Please enter your name.');
  if(!mobile) return authErr('#signupErr','Please enter your mobile number.');
  if(!email) return authErr('#signupErr','Please enter your email.');
  if(pass.length<6) return authErr('#signupErr','Password must be at least 6 characters.');
  if(fb.enabled){
    const b=$('#doSignupBtn'); if(b){ b.disabled=true; b.textContent='Creating…'; }
    try{
      const u = await cloudSignup(name, mobile, email, pass);
      await afterCloudAuth(u, name, email, mobile);
      toast('Welcome, '+name+'! Your account is ready.');
    }catch(e){ authErr('#signupErr', fbErrMsg(e)); }
    finally{ if(b){ b.disabled=false; b.textContent='Create account'; } }
    return;
  }
  try{ const salt=randSalt(); const ph=await hashPass(pass, salt); localStorage.setItem('pluto_account', JSON.stringify({name, mobile, email, salt, ph: ph||('plain:'+pass)})); }catch(e){}
  state.user={name, email, mobile, about:'Available'};
  state.profile={name, about:'Available'};
  save(); hideAuth(); toast('Welcome, '+name+'! Your account is ready.');
}
async function doLogin(){
  authClear('#loginErr');
  const idv=($('#loginMobile').value||'').trim(), pass=$('#loginPass').value;
  if(!idv||!pass) return authErr('#loginErr','Please enter your mobile number and password.');
  if(fb.enabled){
    const b=$('#doLoginBtn'); if(b){ b.disabled=true; b.textContent='Logging in…'; }
    try{
      let email = idv;
      if(idv.indexOf('@')===-1){                       // mobile login (email still works if typed)
        const mk = mobileKeyOf(idv);
        if(mk.length < 7){ authErr('#loginErr','Enter a valid mobile number.'); return; }
        let doc=null; try{ doc = await fb.db.collection('mobiles').doc(mk).get(); }catch(e){}
        if(doc && doc.exists){
          email = ((doc.data()||{}).email || '').toLowerCase();
          if(!email){ authErr('#loginErr','This account has no email on file — please log in with your email.'); return; }
        } else {
          // fallback: find the account by mobile in the users collection (works even if 'mobiles' was never saved)
          let found=null;
          try{ const q = await fb.db.collection('users').where('mobileKey','==',mk).limit(1).get(); if(q && !q.empty) found = q.docs[0].data(); }catch(e){}
          if(!found || !found.email){ authErr('#loginErr','No account with this mobile — please sign up.'); return; }
          email = String(found.email).toLowerCase();
        }
      }
      const u = await fb.auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, pass);
      await afterCloudAuth(u);
      toast('Welcome back!');
    }catch(e){ authErr('#loginErr', fbErrMsg(e)); }
    finally{ if(b){ b.disabled=false; b.textContent='Login'; } }
    return;
  }
  let acc=null;
  try{ acc=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pluto_account')||'null'); }catch(e){}
  if(!acc) return authErr('#loginErr','No account found. Please sign up first.');
  const okId = (acc.email===idv) || (mobileKeyOf(acc.mobile||'')===mobileKeyOf(idv));
  if(!okId) return authErr('#loginErr','No account found with this mobile.');
  let passOk=false;
  if(acc.salt && acc.ph) passOk = ((await hashPass(pass, acc.salt)) === acc.ph);
  else passOk = (acc.pass===pass);
  if(!passOk) return authErr('#loginErr','Incorrect password.');
  state.user={name:acc.name, email:acc.email, about:'Available'};
  state.profile={name:acc.name, about:'Available'};
  save(); hideAuth(); toast('Welcome back, '+acc.name+'!');
}
async function doLogout(){
  setCloudPresence(false);
  stopCallListener();
  if(rtc) rtcCleanup();
  stopCloudChats();
  for(const k in e2eSharedCache) delete e2eSharedCache[k];
  for(const k in e2ePeerPubCache) delete e2ePeerPubCache[k];
  E2E.ready=false; E2E.priv=null; E2E.pub=null;
  if(fb.enabled){ try{ await fb.auth.signOut(); }catch(e){} fb.uid=null; }
  state.user=null; save();
  closeChat();
  $('#newChatSheet').style.display='none';
  showAuth();
  toast('Logged out.');
}

$('#doSignupBtn').onclick = doSignup;

/* ---------- Location sharing ---------- */
function toggleAttachMenu(force){
  const m = $('#attachMenu');
  const show = force!==undefined ? force : !m.classList.contains('show');
  m.classList.toggle('show', show);
  if(show) toggleEmojiPanel(false);
}
function openLocationSheet(){
  toggleAttachMenu(false);
  const note = $('#locNote');
  if(note){
    if(location.protocol==='file:') note.innerHTML = '<b>Real location needs the app served over HTTPS.</b> If you open the file directly, the browser blocks location and nothing will be sent.';
    else if(window.isSecureContext) note.innerHTML = 'Real GPS is active — your actual location will be used.';
    else note.innerHTML = '<b>Real GPS needs HTTPS.</b> Open this page over HTTPS to share your actual location.';
  }
  $('#locationSheet').style.display='flex';
  setTimeout(initPickMap, 60);
}
function closeLocationSheet(){ $('#locationSheet').style.display='none'; }
function getPosition(){
  return new Promise(resolve=>{
    if(!navigator.geolocation) return resolve({error:'unsupported'});
    const ok = p => resolve({lat:p.coords.latitude, lng:p.coords.longitude, acc:p.coords.accuracy});
    const bad = e => resolve({error: (e && e.code===1)?'denied':((e && e.code===2)?'unavailable':'timeout')});
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(ok, err1=>{
      if(err1 && err1.code===1) return bad(err1);
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(ok, bad, {enableHighAccuracy:false, timeout:15000, maximumAge:60000});
    }, {enableHighAccuracy:true, timeout:12000, maximumAge:0});
  });
}
function startWatch(c){
  if(!navigator.geolocation || c.live.watchId!=null) return;
  try{
    c.live.watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(p=>{
      if(!c.live) return;
      c.live.me = {lat:p.coords.latitude, lng:p.coords.longitude};
      c.live.acc = p.coords.accuracy;
      myLastPos = { lat:c.live.me.lat, lng:c.live.me.lng, acc:c.live.acc||null };
      syncLiveMsg(c);
      save();
      if(activeChatId===c.id) renderMessages();
    }, ()=>{}, {enableHighAccuracy:true, maximumAge:3000, timeout:15000});
  }catch(e){}
}
function stopWatch(c){
  if(c && c.live && c.live.watchId!=null){ try{ navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(c.live.watchId); }catch(e){} c.live.watchId=null; }
}
let myLastPos = null;
function liveSelfPos(c){ return (c && c.live && c.live.me) || (c && c.myLoc) || myLastPos || null; }
let voiceOn = true, _lastSpoke = { key:'', ts:0 };
function pickFemaleVoice(){
  try{
    if(!window.speechSynthesis) return null;
    const vs = speechSynthesis.getVoices() || [];
    if(!vs.length) return null;
    const fem = /female|woman|zira|heera|swara|kalpana|lekha|veena|neerja|priya|google हिन्दी|google uk english female|google us english/i;
    let v = vs.find(x=> fem.test(x.name) && /^(hi|en)/i.test(x.lang));
    if(!v) v = vs.find(x=> /hi-IN/i.test(x.lang) && fem.test(x.name));
    if(!v) v = vs.find(x=> /hi-IN/i.test(x.lang));
    if(!v) v = vs.find(x=> /en-IN/i.test(x.lang));
    if(!v) v = vs.find(x=> fem.test(x.name));
    return v || vs[0];
  }catch(e){ return null; }
}
function speakAlert(text){
  if(!voiceOn || !text) return;
  try{
    if(!window.speechSynthesis) return;
    const key = String(text).slice(0,26);
    if(_lastSpoke.key===key && (Date.now()-_lastSpoke.ts) < 25000) return;   // don't repeat the same line too often
    _lastSpoke = { key:key, ts: Date.now() };
    speechSynthesis.cancel();
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    u.lang = 'hi-IN'; u.rate = 1.0; u.pitch = 1.15; u.volume = 1;
    const v = pickFemaleVoice(); if(v) u.voice = v;
    speechSynthesis.speak(u);
  }catch(e){}
}
function updateMeetMetrics(m){
  if(!(m && m.me && m.them)) return;
  const d = haversine(m.me, m.them);
  const t = now();
  m.hist = m.hist || [];
  if(!m._hTs || (t - m._hTs) >= 8000){
    if(m._hTs && m._hD!=null){ const dt=(t-m._hTs)/1000; if(dt>0.5) m._hRate = (d - m._hD)/dt; }   // m/s (+ = moving apart)
    m.hist.push(Math.round(d)); if(m.hist.length>30) m.hist.shift();
    m._hD = d; m._hTs = t;
  }
  const win = m.hist.slice(-4);
  const diff = win.length>=2 ? (win[win.length-1] - win[0]) : 0;
  m.trend = diff < -8 ? 'approach' : (diff > 8 ? 'away' : 'flat');
  // ETA = distance / closing speed (only while actually getting closer)
  if(m.trend==='approach' && m._hRate!=null && m._hRate < -0.15){ m.eta = Math.round(d / (-m._hRate)); }
  else m.eta = null;
  // voice alerts
  try{
    const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
    const nm = (c && c.name) || 'Contact';
    if(d < 30) speakAlert('Aap '+nm+' ke paas pahunch gaye. Bilkul paas hi hain.');
    else if(m.eta!=null && m.eta>0 && m.eta<=120) speakAlert('Bas '+Math.max(1,Math.round(m.eta/60))+' minute me '+nm+' se mil jayenge.');
    else if(m.trend==='away') speakAlert('Savdhan! Doori badh rahi hai. Koi galat raste par ja raha hai.');
    else if(m.trend==='approach') speakAlert(nm+' paas aa raha hai.');
  }catch(e){}
}
function syncLiveMsg(c){
  if(!c) return;
  const self = liveSelfPos(c);
  const peer = c.livePeer || null;
  (c.msgs||[]).forEach(m=>{
    if(m.kind!=='location' || !m.live) return;
    const hadBoth = !!(m.me && m.them);
    if(self){ m.me = { lat:self.lat, lng:self.lng }; }
    if(peer){ m.them = { lat:peer.lat, lng:peer.lng }; if(peer.exp) m.expiresAt = peer.exp; }
    const hasBoth = !!(m.me && m.them);
    if(hasBoth !== hadBoth) c._liveDirty = true;
    if(hasBoth) updateMeetMetrics(m);
  });
}
function maybeFetchSelf(c){
  if(!c || !navigator.geolocation) return;
  if(c.myLoc || myLastPos) return;
  const grab = ()=> getPosition().then(r=>{
    if(r && r.lat!=null){ myLastPos = { lat:r.lat, lng:r.lng, acc:r.acc||null }; c.myLoc = myLastPos; syncLiveMsg(c); if(activeChatId===c.id) renderMessages(); }
  }).catch(()=>{});
  if(navigator.permissions && navigator.permissions.query){
    navigator.permissions.query({name:'geolocation'}).then(st=>{ if(st && st.state==='granted') grab(); }).catch(()=>{});
  }
}
function startLiveSync(c){
  stopLiveSync(c);
  if(!c || !c.cloud || !fb.uid) return;
  const push = async ()=>{
    if(!c.live || !c.live.expiresAt || c.live.expiresAt<=now()) return;
    const pos = liveSelfPos(c); if(!pos) return;
    try{
      // each user writes their OWN live-location doc -> no merge / no conflict possible
      const payload = { lat:pos.lat, lng:pos.lng, acc:c.live.acc||null, exp:c.live.expiresAt, ts:Date.now() };
      await fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).collection('live').doc(fb.uid).set(payload);
      // keep the legacy field too (fallback for older clients)
      await fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).update({ ['liveLoc.'+fb.uid]: payload });
    }catch(e){}
  };
  c.live._timer = setInterval(push, 5000);
  push();
}
function stopLiveSync(c){
  if(c && c.live && c.live._timer){ clearInterval(c.live._timer); c.live._timer=null; }
  if(c && c.cloud && fb.uid){
    try{ fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).collection('live').doc(fb.uid).delete(); }catch(e){}
    try{ fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).update({ ['liveLoc.'+fb.uid]: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.delete() }); }catch(e){}
  }
}
async function applyLiveLoc(c, liveLoc){
  if(!c || !c.cloud) return;
  // restore MY OWN live-share state (so it survives a reload / app restart)
  try{
    const mine = (liveLoc && fb.uid) ? liveLoc[fb.uid] : null;
    const amSharing = !!(c.live && c.live.expiresAt>now());
    if(mine && mine.exp && mine.exp>now() && !amSharing){
      c.live = Object.assign({}, c.live||{}, { expiresAt: mine.exp, cloud:true });
      if(activeChatId===c.id) updateLiveBar();
      // resume sharing after a reload / restart: GPS watch + the periodic cloud push
      maybeFetchSelf(c);
      startWatch(c);
      startLiveSync(c);
    } else if(!mine && amSharing && c.live && c.live.cloud){
      c.live = null;
      if(activeChatId===c.id) updateLiveBar();
    }
  }catch(e){}
  const entry = (liveLoc && c.peerUid) ? liveLoc[c.peerUid] : null;
  const liveMsg = ()=> c.msgs.filter(x=>x.kind==='location' && x.live && x.from==='them').slice(-1)[0] || null;
  if(!entry || (entry.lat==null && !entry.enc) || (entry.exp && entry.exp<=now())){
    c.livePeer = null;
    const m = liveMsg(); if(m){ m.live = false; m.expiresAt = null; m.them = null; }
    if(activeChatId===c.id) renderMessages();
    return;
  }
  try{
    let p;
    if(entry.lat!=null){ p = { lat:entry.lat, lng:entry.lng, acc:entry.acc, ts:entry.ts, exp:entry.exp }; }
    else {
      let peerPub = await e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid); if(!peerPub) peerPub = c.peerPub; if(peerPub) c.peerPub = peerPub;
      if(!peerPub){ if(activeChatId===c.id && !c._liveWarned){ c._liveWarned=true; toast('Live location: waiting for the other phone to set up encryption'); } return; }
      p = await e2eDecrypt(peerPub, entry.enc, entry.iv);
    }
    c.livePeer = { lat:p.lat, lng:p.lng, acc:p.acc, ts:p.ts, exp:p.exp };
    if(c.live) c.live.them = { lat:p.lat, lng:p.lng };
    const m = liveMsg();
    if(m){ m.lat = p.lat; m.lng = p.lng; if(p.acc!=null) m.acc = p.acc; if(p.exp) m.expiresAt = p.exp; m.live = true; }
    maybeFetchSelf(c);
    syncLiveMsg(c);
    if(activeChatId===c.id){
      renderMessages();
      if(document.getElementById('mapScreen') && document.getElementById('mapScreen').classList.contains('show')) drawMap(false);
    }
  }catch(e){ if(activeChatId===c.id && !c._liveWarned){ c._liveWarned=true; toast('Live location: could not decrypt the update'); } }
}
async function shareLocation(mode){
  if(!activeChatId){ toast('Open a chat first'); return; }
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  if(!c){ toast('Chat not found'); return; }
  closeLocationSheet(); toggleAttachMenu(false);
  toast('Getting your location…');
  const res = await getPosition();
  if(!res || res.lat==null){
    let why = 'Could not get your location.';
    if(res && res.error==='denied') why = 'Location permission is blocked — allow it (Settings > Permissions > Location).';
    else if(res && res.error==='unavailable') why = 'Location is off — turn on GPS.';
    else if(res && res.error==='unsupported') why = 'This browser does not support location.';
    else if(location.protocol==='file:') why = 'Real location needs the app served over HTTPS (not opened as a local file).';
    else if(!window.isSecureContext) why = 'Real location needs HTTPS.';
    toast('⚠️ ' + why + ' Nothing was sent.');
    return;
  }
  const pos = {lat:res.lat, lng:res.lng};
  const acc = (res && res.acc) ? res.acc : null;
  const id = now();
  const live = mode!=='current';
  const mins = live ? parseInt(mode,10) : 0;
  const expiresAt = live ? id + mins*60000 : null;
  const msg = {id, from:'me', text:'', ts:id, status:'sent', kind:'location',
    lat:pos.lat, lng:pos.lng, live, expiresAt, real:true, acc};
  if(live){
    if(window.Notification && Notification.permission==='default'){ try{ Notification.requestPermission(); }catch(e){} }
    msg.me = {lat:pos.lat, lng:pos.lng};
    c.live = {msgId:id, me:msg.me, expiresAt, acc};
  }
  if(c && c.cloud){
    cloudSend(c.id, { kind:'location', lat:pos.lat, lng:pos.lng, acc, live, expiresAt, real:true });
    if(live){
      c.live = { expiresAt, me:{lat:pos.lat, lng:pos.lng}, acc, cloud:true, msgId:id };
      myLastPos = { lat:pos.lat, lng:pos.lng, acc:acc||null };
      startWatch(c);
      startLiveSync(c);
    }
    save(); renderMain(); updateLiveBar();
    toast(live ? 'Live location shared (real GPS)' : 'Location shared (real GPS)');
    return;
  }
  c.msgs.push(msg);
  save(); renderMessages(); renderMain(); updateLiveBar();
  setTimeout(()=>{ setStatus(c, id,'delivered'); renderMessages(); }, 700);
  setTimeout(()=>{ setStatus(c, id,'read'); renderMessages(); }, 1500);
  toast(live ? 'Live location shared (real GPS)' : 'Location shared (real GPS)');
  if(live) startWatch(c);
}
function closeConfirm(){ const d=document.getElementById('confirmModal'); if(d){ d.style.display='none'; d._ok=null; } }
function confirmStopLive(id){
  const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  const L=activeLive(c);
  const useId = (id!=null && isFinite(Number(id))) ? Number(id) : (L && (L.msgId!=null ? L.msgId : L.id));
  const d=document.getElementById('confirmModal');
  if(!d){ if(confirm('Would you like to stop sharing your live location?')) stopLive(useId); return; }
  const t=document.getElementById('cfTitle'); if(t) t.textContent='Stop sharing';
  const b=document.getElementById('cfBody'); if(b) b.textContent='Would you like to stop sharing your live location?';
  d._ok = ()=>{ closeConfirm(); stopLive(useId); };
  d.style.display='flex';
}
function stopLive(id){
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  if(!c) return;
  const m = c.msgs.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(m){ m.live=false; m.expiresAt=null; }
  if(c.live){ stopWatch(c); stopLiveSync(c); c.live=null; }
  save(); renderMessages(); updateLiveBar();
  closeMap();   // go back to the chat (no black notice)
}
function endLive(c){
  if(!c || !c.live) return;
  const m = c.msgs.find(x=>x.id===c.live.msgId);
  if(m){ m.live=false; m.expiresAt=null; }
  stopWatch(c);
  stopLiveSync(c);
  c.live=null;
  if(activeChatId===c.id){ closeMap(); renderMessages(); }
  save(); renderMain(); updateLiveBar();
}
function activeLive(c){
  return (c && c.live && c.live.expiresAt>now()) ? c.live : null;
}
/* simulated peer + proximity alerts removed — only real GPS is used */
function updateLiveBar(){
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  const bar = $('#liveBar');
  const L = activeLive(c);
  if(L){
    { const sb=document.getElementById('chatStopBtn'); if(sb) sb.style.display=''; }
    if(L.cloud){
      $('#liveBarText').textContent = 'Sharing live location · ' + compactTime(L.expiresAt) + ' left';
      bar.classList.add('show');
      { const sb=document.getElementById('chatStopBtn'); if(sb) sb.style.display=''; }
      return;
    }
    const m = c.msgs.find(x=>x.id===L.msgId);
    const parts = [];
    if(m && m.me && m.them) parts.push(fmtDist(haversine(m.me, m.them)) + ' apart');
    if(m && m.eta) parts.push('ETA '+etaText(m.eta));
    if(m && m.trend==='approach') parts.push('getting closer');
    else if(m && m.trend==='away') parts.push('⚠️ moving away');
    parts.push(compactTime(L.expiresAt) + ' left');
    $('#liveBarText').textContent = parts.join(' · ');
    bar.classList.add('show');
  } else { bar.classList.remove('show'); const sb=document.getElementById('chatStopBtn'); if(sb) sb.style.display='none'; }
}
setInterval(()=>{
  document.querySelectorAll('#messages [data-exp]').forEach(el=>{
    el.textContent = timeLeft(Number(el.dataset.exp)) + ' left';
  });
  let anyLive=false;
  for(const c of state.chats){
    if(!c.live && !c.livePeer) continue;
    if(c.live && c.live.expiresAt<=now()){ endLive(c); continue; }
    if(c.livePeer && c.livePeer.exp && c.livePeer.exp<=now()){ c.livePeer=null; }
    anyLive=true;
    if((c.live && c.live.cloud) || c.livePeer){
      if(c.livePeer && c.live){ c.live.them = { lat:c.livePeer.lat, lng:c.livePeer.lng }; }
      syncLiveMsg(c);
      if(c._liveDirty && activeChatId===c.id){ c._liveDirty=false; renderMessages(); }
      if(activeChatId===c.id){
        const lm = c.msgs.find(x=>x.kind==='location' && x.live);
        if(lm){
          const ld = (lm.me && lm.them) ? haversine(lm.me, lm.them) : null;
          const lel = document.querySelector(`[data-dist="${lm.id}"]`);
          if(lel && ld!=null) lel.textContent = fmtDist(ld);
          const lmel = document.querySelector(`[data-me="${lm.id}"]`);
          if(lmel && lm.me) lmel.textContent = lm.me.lat.toFixed(4)+', '+lm.me.lng.toFixed(4)+(lm.acc?' · ±'+Math.round(lm.acc)+'m':'');
          const lmm = miniMaps['mm'+lm.id];
          if(lmm && lmm.them && lm.them){ lmm.them.setLatLng([lm.them.lat,lm.them.lng]); if(lmm.me && lm.me) lmm.me.setLatLng([lm.me.lat,lm.me.lng]); if(lmm.line && lm.me && lm.them) lmm.line.setLatLngs([[lm.me.lat,lm.me.lng],[lm.them.lat,lm.them.lng]]); }
        }
      }
      continue;
    }
    syncLiveMsg(c);
    if(c._liveDirty && activeChatId===c.id){ c._liveDirty=false; renderMessages(); }
    if(activeChatId===c.id){
      const m = c.msgs.find(x=>x.kind==='location' && x.live);
      if(m && m.me){
        const mel = document.querySelector(`[data-me="${m.id}"]`);
        if(mel) mel.textContent = m.me.lat.toFixed(4)+', '+m.me.lng.toFixed(4)+(m.acc?' · ±'+Math.round(m.acc)+'m':'');
      }
      const mm = m ? miniMaps['mm'+m.id] : null;
      if(mm && mm.me && m.me) mm.me.setLatLng([m.me.lat,m.me.lng]);
    }
  }
  if(anyLive && document.getElementById('mapScreen').classList.contains('show')) drawMap(false);
  save();
  updateLiveBar();
}, 1000);

/* ---------- Dual live map (Leaflet) ---------- */
/* ---------- Card mini-maps + dual live map (Leaflet) ---------- */
const miniMaps = {};
const TILE_SAT = 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
const TILE_STREET = 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Street_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
const TILE_LABELS = 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Reference/World_Boundaries_and_Places/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
let mapView = 'map';   // 'map' (streets) | 'sat' (satellite) | 'hybrid' (satellite + labels)
let mapSingle = null;  // message shown in the single-location map view
function currentTiles(){ return mapView==='map' ? TILE_STREET : TILE_SAT; }
function miniTiles(mm){ try{ L.tileLayer(currentTiles(), {maxZoom:19}).addTo(mm); if(mapView==='hybrid') L.tileLayer(TILE_LABELS, {maxZoom:19, opacity:0.9}).addTo(mm); }catch(e){} }
function clearMiniMaps(){ Object.keys(miniMaps).forEach(k=>{ try{miniMaps[k].map.remove();}catch(e){} delete miniMaps[k]; }); }
function renderMiniMaps(){
  clearMiniMaps();
  if(!window.L) return;
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  if(!c) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('#messages [data-minimap]').forEach(el=>{
    const m = c.msgs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(el.dataset.minimap));
    if(!m) return;
    const mm = L.map(el, {zoomControl:false, attributionControl:false, dragging:false, scrollWheelZoom:false, doubleClickZoom:false, boxZoom:false, keyboard:false, tap:false, touchZoom:false});
    miniTiles(mm);
    const rec = {map:mm, me:null, them:null, line:null};
    if(m.live && m.me && m.them){
      rec.me = L.circleMarker([m.me.lat,m.me.lng],{radius:6,color:'#fff',weight:2,fillColor:'#0d7d74',fillOpacity:1}).addTo(mm);
      rec.them = L.circleMarker([m.them.lat,m.them.lng],{radius:6,color:'#fff',weight:2,fillColor:'#2f6bd8',fillOpacity:1}).addTo(mm);
      rec.line = L.polyline([[m.me.lat,m.me.lng],[m.them.lat,m.them.lng]],{color:'#0d7d74',weight:4,opacity:.95}).addTo(mm);
      mm.fitBounds([[m.me.lat,m.me.lng],[m.them.lat,m.them.lng]], {padding:[20,20]});
    } else {
      rec.them = L.circleMarker([m.lat,m.lng],{radius:6,color:'#fff',weight:2,fillColor:'#e5484d',fillOpacity:1}).addTo(mm);
      mm.setView([m.lat,m.lng],15);
    }
    miniMaps['mm'+m.id]=rec;
    setTimeout(()=>{ try{mm.invalidateSize();}catch(e){} }, 60);
  });
}
let lmap=null, mapLayers=[], mapMode='dual';
const CHAT_COLORS=['#2f6bd8','#e07a5f','#8e5bb5','#c0504d','#2a9d8f','#b5651d','#4a6fa5','#a14e7a'];
function chatColor(c){ let h=0; for(const ch of c.name) h=(h*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0; return CHAT_COLORS[h%CHAT_COLORS.length]; }
function liveChats(){ return state.chats.filter(c=> (c.live && c.live.expiresAt>now()) || (c.cloud && c.livePeer && (!c.livePeer.exp || c.livePeer.exp>now())) ); }
let lmapTiles = [];
function applyMapTiles(){
  if(!lmap || !window.L) return;
  lmapTiles.forEach(t=>{ try{ lmap.removeLayer(t); }catch(e){} });
  lmapTiles = [];
  lmapTiles.push(L.tileLayer(currentTiles(), {maxZoom:19}).addTo(lmap));
  if(mapView==='hybrid') lmapTiles.push(L.tileLayer(TILE_LABELS, {maxZoom:19, opacity:0.9}).addTo(lmap));
}
function setMapView(v){
  mapView = (v==='sat'||v==='hybrid') ? v : 'map';
  applyMapTiles();
  renderMiniMaps();
  const menu=$('#mapViewMenu'); if(menu) menu.classList.remove('show');
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-mapview]').forEach(b=> b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.mapview===mapView));
}
let pickMap = null;
function initPickMap(){
  const el=document.getElementById('locPickMap'); if(!el || !window.L) return;
  try{ if(pickMap){ pickMap.remove(); pickMap=null; } }catch(e){}
  try{
    pickMap = L.map(el, {zoomControl:false, attributionControl:false});
    L.tileLayer(TILE_STREET, {maxZoom:19}).addTo(pickMap);
    pickMap.setView([myLastPos?myLastPos.lat:28.6139, myLastPos?myLastPos.lng:77.2090], 15);
    if(myLastPos) L.circleMarker([myLastPos.lat,myLastPos.lng], {radius:7,color:'#fff',weight:2,fillColor:'#0d7d74',fillOpacity:1}).addTo(pickMap);
    setTimeout(()=>{ try{ pickMap.invalidateSize(); }catch(e){} }, 80);
    getPosition().then(r=>{
      if(!r || r.lat==null || !pickMap) return;
      myLastPos = { lat:r.lat, lng:r.lng, acc:r.acc||null };
      pickMap.setView([r.lat,r.lng], 16);
      L.circleMarker([r.lat,r.lng], {radius:7,color:'#fff',weight:2,fillColor:'#0d7d74',fillOpacity:1}).addTo(pickMap);
      const a=document.getElementById('locAcc'); if(a) a.textContent = 'Accurate to '+(r.acc?Math.round(r.acc)+' meters':'a few meters');
    }).catch(()=>{});
  }catch(e){}
}
function updateMapPanel(){
  const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  const sharingMe = !!(c && c.live && c.live.expiresAt>now());
  const peer = c && c.livePeer;
  const me = liveSelfPos(c);
  const them = (c && (c.livePeer || (c.live && c.live.them))) || null;
  const nameEl=document.getElementById('mapPanelName'), avEl=document.getElementById('mapPanelAv'), durEl=document.getElementById('mapDur'), upEl=document.getElementById('mapUpdated');
  const durTxt = () => (c && c.live && c.live.expiresAt>now()) ? compactTime(c.live.expiresAt) : ((peer && peer.exp) ? compactTime(peer.exp) : '—');
  if(me && them){
    const d=haversine(me,them), mid=midpointOf(me,them);
    const dMe=haversine(me,mid), dThem=haversine(them,mid);
    const nm=(c&&c.name)||'Contact';
    const who = (Math.abs(dMe-dThem)<15) ? 'both about the same' : ((dMe>dThem?'You':nm)+' is farther');
    if(nameEl) nameEl.textContent = fmtDist(d)+' apart';
    if(avEl) avEl.textContent='Y';
    if(durEl) durEl.textContent = durTxt();
    if(upEl) upEl.textContent = who+' from meet point · You '+fmtDist(dMe)+' · '+nm+' '+fmtDist(dThem);
  } else if(sharingMe){
    if(nameEl) nameEl.textContent='You';
    if(avEl) avEl.textContent='Y';
    if(durEl) durEl.textContent = compactTime(c.live.expiresAt);
    if(upEl) upEl.textContent='Updated just now';
  } else if(peer){
    if(nameEl) nameEl.textContent = (c&&c.name)||'Contact';
    if(avEl) avEl.textContent = INI((c&&c.name)||'C');
    if(durEl) durEl.textContent = peer.exp ? compactTime(peer.exp) : '—';
    if(upEl) upEl.textContent='Updated just now';
  } else { if(durEl) durEl.textContent='—'; }
  const sb=document.getElementById('mapStopBtn'); if(sb) sb.style.display='';
}
function initLeaflet(){
  if(!window.L) return false;
  if(!lmap){
    lmap = L.map('leafletMap', {zoomControl:true, attributionControl:false});
    applyMapTiles();
  }
  return true;
}
function clearMapLayers(){ mapLayers.forEach(l=>{ try{lmap.removeLayer(l);}catch(e){} }); mapLayers=[]; }
function addMapMarker(lat,lng,color,label){
  const ic = L.divIcon({className:'', html:`<div class="mk" style="background:${color}">${label}</div>`, iconSize:[30,30], iconAnchor:[15,15]});
  const mk = L.marker([lat,lng], {icon:ic}).addTo(lmap);
  mapLayers.push(mk); return mk;
}
function drawMap(fit){
  if(!initLeaflet()) return;
  clearMapLayers();
  const pts=[];
  const lives=liveChats();
  if(mapMode==='single'){
    const m=mapSingle;
    const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
    const me = liveSelfPos(c);
    const them = (c && (c.livePeer || (c.live && c.live.them))) || null;
    if(m && Number.isFinite(Number(m.lat))){ addMapMarker(m.lat, m.lng, '#e5484d', ''); pts.push([m.lat,m.lng]); }
    if(me && them){
      // both are sharing live location -> show both + the meet point + distance (#13)
      addMapMarker(me.lat,me.lng,'#0d7d74','Y'); pts.push([me.lat,me.lng]);
      addMapMarker(them.lat,them.lng,'#2f6bd8','P'); pts.push([them.lat,them.lng]);
      const cas=L.polyline([[me.lat,me.lng],[them.lat,them.lng]],{color:'#ffffff',weight:9,opacity:.85}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(cas);
      const ln=L.polyline([[me.lat,me.lng],[them.lat,them.lng]],{color:'#0d7d74',weight:4,opacity:.95}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(ln);
      const mid=midpointOf(me,them);
      const mk=L.marker([mid.lat,mid.lng], {icon:L.divIcon({className:'', html:'<div class="mk" style="background:#d97706">M</div>', iconSize:[30,30], iconAnchor:[15,15]})}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(mk);
      [[me,mid],[them,mid]].forEach(pr=>{ const dl=L.polyline([[pr[0].lat,pr[0].lng],[pr[1].lat,pr[1].lng]],{color:'#d97706',weight:2,dashArray:'6 6',opacity:.85}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(dl); });
      const dv=document.getElementById('mapDist'); if(dv) dv.textContent=fmtDist(haversine(me,them));
      const dl2=document.getElementById('mapDistLbl'); if(dl2) dl2.textContent='DISTANCE APART';
      const badge=document.querySelector('.map-dist-badge'); if(badge) badge.style.display='';
      if(lmap) lmap.fitBounds(pts,{padding:[70,70],maxZoom:16});
    } else {
      if(m && Number.isFinite(Number(m.lat)) && lmap) lmap.setView([m.lat,m.lng],16);
    }
    return;
  }
  if(mapMode==='dual'){
    const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
    const me = liveSelfPos(c);
    const them = (c && (c.livePeer || (c.live && c.live.them))) || null;
    if(me || them){
      if(me){ addMapMarker(me.lat,me.lng,'#0d7d74','Y'); pts.push([me.lat,me.lng]); }
      if(them){ addMapMarker(them.lat,them.lng,'#2f6bd8','P'); pts.push([them.lat,them.lng]); }
      if(me && them){
        const cas=L.polyline([[me.lat,me.lng],[them.lat,them.lng]],{color:'#ffffff',weight:9,opacity:.85}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(cas);
        const ln=L.polyline([[me.lat,me.lng],[them.lat,them.lng]],{color:'#0d7d74',weight:4,opacity:.95}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(ln);
        const mid=midpointOf(me,them);
        const mk=L.marker([mid.lat,mid.lng], {icon:L.divIcon({className:'', html:'<div class="mk" style="background:#d97706">M</div>', iconSize:[30,30], iconAnchor:[15,15]})}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(mk);
        [[me,mid],[them,mid]].forEach(pr=>{ const dl=L.polyline([[pr[0].lat,pr[0].lng],[pr[1].lat,pr[1].lng]],{color:'#d97706',weight:2,dashArray:'6 6',opacity:.85}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(dl); });
      }
      $('#mapDist').textContent = (me&&them) ? fmtDist(haversine(me,them)) : '—';
      $('#mapDistLbl').textContent = (me&&them) ? 'DISTANCE APART' : 'LIVE LOCATION';
    }
  } else {
    const myMe = (()=>{ for(const c of lives){ if(c.live && c.live.me) return c.live.me; } return null; })();
    if(myMe){ addMapMarker(myMe.lat,myMe.lng,'#0d7d74','Y'); pts.push([myMe.lat,myMe.lng]); }
    const used = new Set(['#0d7d74']);
    lives.forEach(c=>{
      const them = c.livePeer || (c.live && c.live.them) || null;
      if(!them) return;
      let col = chatColor(c);
      if(used.has(col)){ for(const cc of CHAT_COLORS){ if(!used.has(cc)){ col=cc; break; } } }
      used.add(col);
      addMapMarker(them.lat,them.lng,col,INI(c.name).slice(0,1));
      pts.push([them.lat,them.lng]);
      const me = (c.live && c.live.me) || myMe;
      if(me){ const cas=L.polyline([[me.lat,me.lng],[them.lat,them.lng]],{color:'#ffffff',weight:7,opacity:.8}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(cas); const ln=L.polyline([[me.lat,me.lng],[them.lat,them.lng]],{color:col,weight:3,opacity:.9}).addTo(lmap); mapLayers.push(ln); }
    });
    let near=null, nd=Infinity;
    lives.forEach(c=>{ const them=c.livePeer||(c.live&&c.live.them); const me=(c.live&&c.live.me)||myMe; if(them&&me){ const d=haversine(me,them); if(d<nd){nd=d;near=c;} } });
    $('#mapDist').textContent = near ? fmtDist(nd) : '—';
    $('#mapDistLbl').textContent = near ? ('NEAREST · '+near.name.split(' ')[0].toUpperCase()) : 'NO LIVE LOCATIONS';
  }
  if(fit && pts.length){
    if(pts.length===1) lmap.setView(pts[0],15);
    else lmap.fitBounds(pts,{padding:[64,64],maxZoom:16});
  }
}
function openMap(mode, msg){
  mapMode = (mode==='all') ? 'all' : (mode==='single' ? 'single' : 'dual');
  mapSingle = (mapMode==='single') ? (msg||null) : null;
  const lives=liveChats();
  if(mapMode==='single'){
    const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
    if(!mapSingle || !Number.isFinite(Number(mapSingle.lat))){ toast('Location not available'); return; }
    $('#mapTitle').textContent=(c&&c.name)||'Location';
    const _me=liveSelfPos(c), _them=(c && (c.livePeer || (c.live && c.live.them))) || null;
    $('#mapSub').textContent = (_me && _them) ? ('You & '+((c&&c.name)||'Contact')+' · sharing') : 'Shared location';
  } else if(mapMode==='dual'){
    const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
    if(!c || (!c.live && !c.livePeer)){ toast('No live location is active'); return; }
    $('#mapTitle').textContent=c.name;
    $('#mapSub').textContent='You & contact sharing';
    if(!liveSelfPos(c) && navigator.geolocation){
      getPosition().then(r=>{ if(r && r.lat!=null){ myLastPos={lat:r.lat,lng:r.lng,acc:r.acc||null}; c.myLoc=myLastPos; syncLiveMsg(c); if(document.getElementById('mapScreen').classList.contains('show')) drawMap(false); } }).catch(()=>{});
    }
  } else {
    if(!lives.length){ toast('No live location is active'); return; }
    $('#mapTitle').textContent='All live locations';
    $('#mapSub').textContent=lives.length+' contacts sharing';
  }
  { const pn=document.querySelector('.map-panel'); if(pn) pn.style.display = (mapMode==='single') ? 'none' : ''; }
  { const db=document.querySelector('.map-dist-badge'); if(db) db.style.display = (mapMode==='single') ? 'none' : ''; }
  updateMapPanel();
  setMapView(mapView);
  $('#mapScreen').classList.add('show');
  setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!initLeaflet()){ toast('Map did not load — check your internet'); return; }
    lmap.invalidateSize(); drawMap(true);
  }, 60);
}
function closeMap(){ $('#mapScreen').classList.remove('show'); }

}

let mvUrl = null;
function showMediaViewer(url, kind){
  const v=$('#mediaViewer'), b=$('#mvBody');
  if(!v || !b){ try{ window.open(url,'_blank'); }catch(e){} return; }
  if(mvUrl){ try{ URL.revokeObjectURL(mvUrl); }catch(e){} }
  mvUrl = (url && url.startsWith('blob:')) ? url : null;
  b.innerHTML = (kind==='video')
    ? `<video src="${url}" controls autoplay playsinline></video>`
    : `<img src="${url}" alt="media">`;
  v.classList.add('show');
}
function closeMediaViewer(){
  const v=$('#mediaViewer'), b=$('#mvBody');
  if(v) v.classList.remove('show');
  if(b) b.innerHTML='';
  if(mvUrl){ try{ URL.revokeObjectURL(mvUrl); }catch(e){} mvUrl=null; }
}
