/* ---------- Media: files, camera, voice, permissions ---------- */
function fmtSize(b){ if(!b) return ''; if(b<1024) return b+' B'; if(b<1048576) return Math.round(b/1024)+' KB'; return (b/1048576).toFixed(1)+' MB'; }
function fileIconSvg(){ return '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8Z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6"/></svg>'; }
function linkify(raw){
  let s = esc(raw==null?'':String(raw));      // already HTML-escaped -> safe to inject
  return s.replace(/\b((?:https?:\/\/|www\.)[^\s<]+)/gi, function(u){
    let trail='';
    const mt = u.match(/[.,)\]}]+$/);
    if(mt){ trail = mt[0]; u = u.slice(0, u.length-trail.length); }
    if(!u) return mt?mt[0]:'';
    const href = /^https?:\/\//i.test(u) ? u : ('https://'+u);
    return '<a class="chat-link" href="'+href+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">'+u+'</a>'+trail;
  });
}
function msgBody(m, out){
  if(m.uploading){
    const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, m.progress||0));
    const bg = m.thumb
      ? `<img src="${m.thumb}" style="width:100%;border-radius:10px;display:block;opacity:.5" alt="uploading">`
      : `<div style="width:210px;height:130px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface-2);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:22px">${m.kind==='video'?'🎥':m.kind==='image'?'📷':'📄'}</div>`;
    return `<div style="position:relative;max-width:240px">${bg}<div style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;text-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.9)">Uploading ${pct}%</div></div>`;
  }
  if(m.kind==='location') return locBubble(m, out);
  if(m.kind==='image') return `<img class="photo" src="${m.thumb||m.url||m.data}" data-openmedia="${m.id}" alt="${esc(m.name||'photo')}">`;
  if(m.kind==='video'){
    if(m.iv) return `<div data-openmedia="${m.id}" style="position:relative;cursor:pointer;max-width:240px"><img src="${m.thumb||''}" style="width:100%;border-radius:10px;display:block" alt="video"><span style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:34px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.7)">▶</span></div>`;
    return `<video class="photo" src="${m.url||m.data}"${m.thumb?` poster="${m.thumb}"`:''} controls playsinline preload="metadata"></video>`;
  }
  if(m.kind==='file'){
    const nm = esc(m.name||'File'), sz = fmtSize(m.size), isAudio = (m.mime||'').startsWith('audio/');
    if(m.url||m.data){
      const _u=m.url||m.data;
      return `<div class="file-card file-rich"><div class="fi">${fileIconSvg()}</div><div class="fn"><div class="a">${nm}</div><div class="b">${sz}</div>${(isAudio && !m.iv)?`<audio controls preload="metadata" src="${_u}" style="margin-top:6px;max-width:210px;height:32px"></audio>`:''}<button class="mini" data-openmedia="${m.id}" style="margin-top:6px">Open / Save</button></div></div>`;
    }
    return `<div class="file-card"><div class="fi">${fileIconSvg()}</div><div class="fn"><div class="a">${nm}</div><div class="b">${sz} · file not attached</div></div></div>`;
  }
  if(m.kind==='voice') return `<div class="voice"><button class="vplay" data-play="${m.id}">▶</button><div class="vwave"></div><span class="vdur">${m.dur||0}s</span><audio data-audio="${m.id}" src="${m.url||m.data}" preload="metadata"></audio></div>`;
  return `<div class="txt">${linkify(m.text)}</div>`;
}
function toggleAudio(id){
  const a=document.querySelector(`audio[data-audio="${id}"]`); const b=document.querySelector(`[data-play="${id}"]`);
  if(!a) return;
  messagesEl.querySelectorAll('audio[data-audio]').forEach(x=>{ if(x!==a){ x.pause(); const bb=document.querySelector(`[data-play="${x.dataset.audio}"]`); if(bb) bb.textContent='▶'; } });
  if(a.paused){ a.play().catch(()=>{}); if(b) b.textContent='❚❚'; } else { a.pause(); if(b) b.textContent='▶'; }
}
function readAsDataURL(file){ return new Promise(res=>{ const r=new FileReader(); r.onload=()=>res(r.result); r.onerror=()=>res(null); r.readAsDataURL(file); }); }
function downscaleImage(file, max, q){
  return new Promise(res=>{
    const img=new Image(); const url=URL.createObjectURL(file);
    img.onload=()=>{ let w=img.width,h=img.height;
      if(w>=h && w>max){ h=Math.round(h*max/w); w=max; } else if(h>w && h>max){ w=Math.round(w*max/h); h=max; }
      const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=w; cv.height=h;
      cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,w,h); URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      res(cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg',q));
    };
    img.onerror=()=>{ URL.revokeObjectURL(url); res(null); };
    img.src=url;
  });
}
function pushMedia(c, obj){
  if(c && c.cloud){ cloudSend(c.id, obj); return; }
  const id=now();
  const m=Object.assign({id, from:'me', text:'', ts:id, status:'sent'}, obj);
  c.msgs.push(m);
  save(); renderMessages(); renderMain();
  setTimeout(()=>{ setStatus(c,id,'delivered'); renderMessages(); },600);
  setTimeout(()=>{ setStatus(c,id,'read'); renderMessages(); },1200);
}
const MAX_FILE_BYTES = 500*1024;              // inline (base64 in Firestore) limit
const MAX_MEDIA_BYTES = 50*1024*1024;         // with a media host
function mediaHostReady(){ const c=getCloudinary(); return !!(c && c.cloud && c.preset); }
async function encryptBytes(bytes, peerPub){
  const key = await e2eSharedKey(peerPub);
  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const ct = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'AES-GCM', iv}, key, bytes);
  return { blob: new Blob([ct], {type:'application/octet-stream'}), iv: bufToB64(iv) };
}
async function decryptBytes(buf, ivB64, peerPub){
  const key = await e2eSharedKey(peerPub);
  return crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM', iv: b64ToBuf(ivB64)}, key, buf);
}
const CLOUD_SAFE_EXT = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|bmp|mp4|mov|webm|mkv|mp3|m4a|wav|ogg|pdf|zip|rar|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?|txt|csv)$/i;
function safeUploadName(name){
  let n = (name||'pluto').replace(/[^\w.\-]+/g,'_').slice(-70);
  if(!CLOUD_SAFE_EXT.test(n)) n = n.replace(/\.[^.]*$/,'') + '.txt';   // Cloudinary blocks some extensions (apk, bin, ...)
  return n || 'pluto.txt';
}
function uploadMedia(blob, name, onProgress){
  const cfg = getCloudinary();
  if(!cfg || !cfg.cloud || !cfg.preset) return Promise.resolve({ error:'no-host' });
  return new Promise((resolve)=>{
    try{
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('file', blob, safeUploadName(name));
      fd.append('upload_preset', cfg.preset);
      /* /raw/upload: bytes are stored as-is (encrypted data is opaque; "auto" would
         try to process it as image/video and fail). XHR gives us progress. */
      const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
      xhr.open('POST', 'https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/'+encodeURIComponent(cfg.cloud)+'/raw/upload');
      if(onProgress && xhr.upload){ xhr.upload.onprogress = (e)=>{ try{ if(e.lengthComputable) onProgress(Math.round(e.loaded/e.total*100)); }catch(_){} }; }
      xhr.onload = ()=>{ let j={}; try{ j=JSON.parse(xhr.responseText||'{}'); }catch(e){}
        if(j && j.secure_url) resolve({ url: j.secure_url });
        else resolve({ error: (j && j.error && j.error.message) || ('upload failed ('+xhr.status+')') }); };
      xhr.onerror = ()=>resolve({ error:'network error' });
      xhr.onabort = ()=>resolve({ error:'cancelled' });
      xhr.send(fd);
    }catch(e){ resolve({ error:e.message||'upload failed' }); }
  });
}
function videoThumb(file){
  return new Promise(res=>{
    try{
      const v=document.createElement('video'); v.preload='metadata'; v.muted=true; v.playsInline=true;
      const url=URL.createObjectURL(file); let done=false;
      const finish=(val)=>{ if(done) return; done=true; try{URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}catch(e){} res(val); };
      v.onloadeddata=()=>{ try{ v.currentTime=0.1; }catch(e){ finish(null); } };
      v.onseeked=()=>{ try{
          let w=v.videoWidth,h=v.videoHeight; const max=360;
          if(w>=h && w>max){ h=Math.round(h*max/w); w=max; } else if(h>w && h>max){ w=Math.round(w*max/h); h=max; }
          const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=w; cv.height=h;
          cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(v,0,0,w,h); finish(cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.6));
        }catch(e){ finish(null); } };
      v.onerror=()=>finish(null);
      setTimeout(()=>finish(null), 5000);
      v.src=url;
    }catch(e){ res(null); }
  });
}
async function handleFile(file, isPhoto){
  if(!file || !activeChatId) return;
  const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); if(!c) return;
  const mime = file.type || '';
  const kind = mime.startsWith('image/') ? 'image' : mime.startsWith('video/') ? 'video' : 'file';
  const host = mediaHostReady();
  let peerPub = null;
  if(c.cloud){ peerPub = c.peerPub || await e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid); if(peerPub) c.peerPub = peerPub; }
  const canEncrypt = !!(host && peerPub && E2E.ready);
  const cap = host ? MAX_MEDIA_BYTES : MAX_FILE_BYTES;
  if(file.size > cap){ toast('File too large — max '+(host?'50 MB':'500 KB')+'.'); return; }
  const obj = { kind, name:file.name||('pluto-'+kind), size:file.size, mime };
  if(kind==='image'){ const t=await downscaleImage(file,360,0.6); if(t) obj.thumb=t; }
  else if(kind==='video'){ const t=await videoThumb(file); if(t) obj.thumb=t; }
  if(!host){
    if(file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES){ toast('Max 500 KB without a media host. Set Cloudinary in Settings > Backend.'); return; }
    if(kind==='image'){ const d=await downscaleImage(file,1024,0.7); if(!d){ toast('Image could not be processed'); return; } obj.data=d; }
    else { const d=await readAsDataURL(file); if(!d){ toast('File could not be read'); return; } obj.data=d; }
    pushMedia(c, obj); return;
  }
  // show the message immediately, with an upload progress bar
  const tmp = Object.assign({ id:'tmp_'+now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2), from:'me', text:'', ts:Date.now(), status:'sent', uploading:true, progress:0 }, obj);
  c.msgs.push(tmp);
  const repaint = ()=>{ if(activeChatId===c.id) renderMessages(); };
  repaint(); renderMain();
  const onProg = (pp)=>{ tmp.progress = pp; repaint(); };
  try{
    let up = null;
    if(canEncrypt){
      const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const enc = await encryptBytes(bytes, peerPub);
      up = await uploadMedia(enc.blob, obj.name, onProg);
      if(up && up.url){ obj.url = up.url; obj.iv = enc.iv; }
    } else {
      up = await uploadMedia(file, obj.name, onProg);
      if(up && up.url){ obj.url = up.url; if(c.cloud) toast('Sent WITHOUT end-to-end encryption — set up encryption (Settings > Security) for privacy'); }
    }
    if(up && up.error){ toast('Upload failed: '+up.error+' — check the Cloudinary preset is Unsigned'); }
  }catch(e){ toast('Upload failed: '+(e.message||'')); }
  c.msgs = c.msgs.filter(x=>x!==tmp);
  if(!obj.url){
    if(file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES){ toast('Upload failed — check the Cloudinary preset is Unsigned (Settings > Backend)'); renderMessages(); renderMain(); return; }
    if(kind==='image'){ const d=await downscaleImage(file,1024,0.7); if(d) obj.data=d; }
    else { const d=await readAsDataURL(file); if(d) obj.data=d; }
    if(!obj.data){ toast('File could not be sent'); renderMessages(); renderMain(); return; }
  }
  pushMedia(c, obj);
  renderMessages(); renderMain();
}
async function openMedia(m){
  if(!m) return;
  try{
    if(m.url && m.iv){
      const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
      const peerPub = c ? (c.peerPub || await e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid)) : null;
      if(!peerPub){ toast('Encryption key not ready'); return; }
      toast('Opening…');
      const r = await fetch(m.url); if(!r.ok) throw new Error('download failed');
      const buf = await r.arrayBuffer();
      const pt = await decryptBytes(buf, m.iv, peerPub);
      const blob = new Blob([pt], {type:m.mime||'application/octet-stream'});
      const u = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      if(m.kind==='image' || m.kind==='video'){ showMediaViewer(u, m.kind); }
      else { const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=u; a.download=m.name||('pluto-'+m.kind); document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u), 30000); }
      return;
    }
    let u = m.url || m.data;
    if(u && u.startsWith('data:')){ try{ const b=await (await fetch(u)).blob(); u=URL.createObjectURL(b); }catch(e){} }
    else if(m.url && m.mime){ try{ const b=await (await fetch(m.url)).blob(); u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([b], {type:m.mime})); }catch(e){} }
    if(m.kind==='image' || m.kind==='video'){ if(u) showMediaViewer(u, m.kind); else toast('Nothing to open'); }
    else if(u){ const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=u; a.download=m.name||('pluto-'+m.kind); a.target='_blank'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); }
    else toast('Nothing to open');
  }catch(e){ toast('Could not open — '+(e.message||'')); }
}
async function saveMedia(url, name){
  if(!url){ toast('Nothing to save'); return; }
  try{
    if(url.startsWith('data:')){
      const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=url; a.download=name||'pluto-file'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      toast('Saved'); return;
    }
    const r=await fetch(url); const b=await r.blob();
    const u=URL.createObjectURL(b); const a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=u; a.download=name||'pluto-file'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u), 5000); toast('Saved');
  }catch(e){ toast('Could not save — try Open'); }
}
let camStream=null, camFacing='environment', cameraTarget='chat';
async function openCamera(){
  toggleAttachMenu(false);
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){ toast('Camera is not supported in this browser'); return; }
  try{ camStream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video:{facingMode:camFacing}, audio:false}); }
  catch(e){ toast((e&&e.name==='NotAllowedError')?'Camera permission denied':'Could not open camera'); return; }
  const v=$('#camVideo'); if(v){ v.srcObject=camStream; v.play().catch(()=>{}); }
  $('#cameraSheet').style.display='flex';
}
function closeCamera(){
  const v=$('#camVideo'); if(v){ try{v.pause();}catch(e){} v.srcObject=null; }
  if(camStream){ camStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); camStream=null; }
  $('#cameraSheet').style.display='none';
}
function flipCamera(){ camFacing = camFacing==='environment'?'user':'environment'; closeCamera(); openCamera(); }
function shootPhoto(){
  const v=$('#camVideo'); if(!v || !v.videoWidth){ toast('Camera is not ready'); return; }
  const max=640; let w=v.videoWidth,h=v.videoHeight;
  if(w>=h && w>max){ h=Math.round(h*max/w); w=max; } else if(h>w && h>max){ w=Math.round(w*max/h); h=max; }
  const cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=w; cv.height=h;
  cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(v,0,0,w,h);
  const data=cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg',0.6);
  closeCamera();
  if(cameraTarget==='story'){ cameraTarget='chat'; addStoryItem({kind:'image', data}); return; }
  const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  if(c) pushMedia(c,{kind:'image', data, name:'camera.jpg', size:Math.round(data.length*0.75), mime:'image/jpeg'});
}
let mediaRec=null, recChunks=[], recStart=0, recTimer=null;
function showRecBar(){ const b=$('#recBar'); if(b) b.classList.add('show'); recStart=Date.now(); clearInterval(recTimer);
  recTimer=setInterval(()=>{ const s=Math.floor((Date.now()-recStart)/1000); const el=$('#recTime'); if(el) el.textContent=Math.floor(s/60)+':'+String(s%60).padStart(2,'0'); if(s>=60) stopVoice(); },250);
}
function hideRecBar(){ const b=$('#recBar'); if(b) b.classList.remove('show'); clearInterval(recTimer); recTimer=null; }
async function startVoice(){
  toggleAttachMenu(false);
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices || !window.MediaRecorder){ toast('Recording is not supported in this browser'); return; }
  let stream;
  try{ stream=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true}); }
  catch(e){ toast((e&&e.name==='NotAllowedError')?'Mic permission denied':'Mic not found'); return; }
  recChunks=[];
  try{ mediaRec=new MediaRecorder(stream); }catch(e){ stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); toast('Recording could not start'); return; }
  mediaRec.ondataavailable=e=>{ if(e.data && e.data.size) recChunks.push(e.data); };
  mediaRec.onstop=async ()=>{
    stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
    const dur=Math.max(1,Math.round((Date.now()-recStart)/1000));
    const blob=new Blob(recChunks,{type:mediaRec.mimeType||'audio/webm'});
    hideRecBar();
    if(blob.size>MAX_FILE_BYTES){ toast('Voice note is too large to send'); return; }
    const data=await readAsDataURL(blob);
    const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
    if(c && data) pushMedia(c,{kind:'voice', data, dur, size:blob.size, mime:blob.type});
  };
  mediaRec.start(); showRecBar();
}
function stopVoice(){ if(mediaRec && mediaRec.state!=='inactive') mediaRec.stop(); }
async function permState(name){ try{ const p=await navigator.permissions.query({name}); return p.state; }catch(e){ return 'unknown'; } }
function permLabel(s){ return s==='granted'?'Allowed':s==='denied'?'Blocked':s==='prompt'?'Not asked':'—'; }
async function renderPerms(){
  const list=$('#permList'); if(!list) return;
  const geo=await permState('geolocation');
  const cam=await permState('camera');
  const mic=await permState('microphone');
  const notif=('Notification' in window)?Notification.permission:'unknown';
  const rows=[
    ['location','Location','Your GPS location',geo],
    ['notifications','Notifications','ETA / alerts',notif],
    ['camera','Camera','To take a photo',cam],
    ['mic','Microphone','For voice messages',mic],
    ['files','Photos & files','To send in chat','prompt']
  ];
  const ic={
    location:'<path d="M21 10c0 7-9 12-9 12s-9-5-9-12a9 9 0 0 1 18 0Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/>',
    notifications:'<path d="M18 8a6 6 0 1 0-12 0c0 7-3 9-3 9h18s-3-2-3-9"/><path d="M13.7 21a2 2 0 0 1-3.4 0"/>',
    camera:'<path d="M23 19a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4l2-3h6l2 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2Z"/><circle cx="12" cy="13" r="4"/>',
    mic:'<rect x="9" y="2" width="6" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M5 10a7 7 0 0 0 14 0M12 19v3"/>',
    files:'<path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8Z"/><path d="M14 2v6h6"/>'
  };
  list.innerHTML = rows.map(([k,t,d,st])=>`
    <div class="perm-row">
      <div class="ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">${ic[k]}</svg></div>
      <div class="tx"><div class="a">${t}</div><div class="b">${d}</div></div>
      <span class="st ${st}">${permLabel(st)}</span>
      <button class="go" data-perm="${k}">${st==='granted'?'✓':'Allow'}</button>
    </div>`).join('') +
    `<div class="loc-note">${location.protocol==='file:'?'<b>Note:</b> open over HTTPS (not as a local file) for real GPS / camera / mic.':'Tap <b>Allow</b> on each row — the phone will ask, then it becomes <b>Allowed</b>. If Location shows <b>Blocked</b>, enable it in phone/browser settings.'}</div>`;
}
function openPermSheet(){ $('#permSheet').style.display='flex'; renderPerms(); }
async function requestPerm(kind){
  try{
    if(kind==='location'){
      let st='unknown';
      try{ if(navigator.permissions){ st=(await navigator.permissions.query({name:'geolocation'})).state; } }catch(e){}
      if(st==='denied'){ toast('Location is BLOCKED — allow it in your phone/browser settings for this app'); }
      else { const r=await getPosition(); if(r && r.lat!=null){ toast('Location enabled ✓ '+r.lat.toFixed(4)+', '+r.lng.toFixed(4)); } else { toast('Could not get location — allow it when asked, and turn on GPS'); } }
    }
    else if(kind==='notifications'){ if('Notification' in window) await Notification.requestPermission(); }
    else if(kind==='camera'){ const s=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video:true}); s.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); }
    else if(kind==='mic'){ const s=await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true}); s.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); }
    else if(kind==='files'){ $('#filePhoto').click(); }
  }catch(e){ toast((e&&e.name==='NotAllowedError')?'Permission denied':'Permission not granted'); }
  setTimeout(renderPerms, 400);
}

/* ---------- Settings engine ---------- */
const WALLPAPERS = { default:null, paper:'#fbf7f0', mint:'#eef8f4', sky:'#eef4fb', rose:'#fdeef2', night:'#0c1a19' };
function tickHTML(m){
  const rr = state.settings ? state.settings.readReceipts : true;
  if(m.status==='read' && rr) return TICK_SVG('read');
  if(m.status==='delivered' || m.status==='read') return TICK_SVG('deliv');
  return TICK1_SVG('deliv');
}
function applySettings(){
  const s = state.settings || {};
  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = s.theme || 'auto';
  const m = document.getElementById('messages');
  if(m){ m.style.background = WALLPAPERS[s.wallpaper] || ''; }
}
function setTheme(t){ state.settings.theme = t; save(); applySettings(); renderMain(); toast('Theme: '+t); }
function toggleSetting(key){
  state.settings[key] = !state.settings[key];
  save(); applySettings(); renderMain();
  if($('#settingsSheet').style.display==='flex') renderSettingsSection(currentSettingsSection);
  const nm = {readReceipts:'Read receipts',lastSeen:'Last seen',profilePhoto:'Profile photo',notifMessages:'Message notifications',notifGroups:'Group notifications',notifCalls:'Call notifications'}[key]||key;
  toast(nm+': '+(state.settings[key]?'ON':'OFF'));
}
let currentSettingsSection = null;
function openSettingsSection(name){
  currentSettingsSection = name;
  const titles = {profile:'Profile',notifications:'Notifications',privacy:'Privacy',chats:'Chat settings',security:'Security'};
  $('#settingsTitle').textContent = titles[name] || 'Settings';
  renderSettingsSection(name);
  $('#settingsSheet').style.display='flex';
}
function closeSettingsSheet(){ $('#settingsSheet').style.display='none'; }
function settingsToggleRow(key,title,sub){
  const on = !!state.settings[key];
  return `<div class="setting-row" data-skey="${key}">
    <div class="tx"><div class="a">${title}</div><div class="b">${sub}</div></div>
    <div class="switch ${on?'on':''}" data-switch="${key}"></div>
  </div>`;
}
function blockedHTML(){
  const b = state.blocked||[];
  if(!b.length) return `<div class="set-note">No blocked contacts.</div>`;
  return b.map(n=>`<div class="blocked-row"><div class="t">${esc(n)}</div><button class="ub" data-unblock="${esc(n)}">Unblock</button></div>`).join('');
}
function storageHTML(){
  let bytes=0; try{ bytes=(localStorage.getItem('pluto_state')||'').length; }catch(e){}
  const chats=(state.chats||[]).length;
  const msgs=(state.chats||[]).reduce((n,c)=>n+(c.msgs?c.msgs.length:0),0);
  return `<div>${chats} chats · ${msgs} messages</div><div>Approx ${fmtSize(bytes)} storage used</div>`;
}
function renderSettingsSection(name){
  const s = state.settings, u = state.user || state.profile || {};
  const body = $('#settingsBody'); if(!body) return;
  let html='';
  if(name==='profile'){
    html = `<div class="set-form">
      <div class="field"><label>Name</label><input id="pfName" value="${esc(u.name||'')}"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Mobile number</label><input id="pfMobile" type="tel" value="${esc(u.mobile||'')}"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Email</label><input id="pfEmail" type="email" value="${esc(u.email||'')}"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>About</label><input id="pfAbout" value="${esc(u.about||'')}"></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="saveProfile">Save changes</button>
    </div>`;
  } else if(name==='notifications'){
    html = settingsToggleRow('notifMessages','Message notifications','For new messages')
         + settingsToggleRow('notifGroups','Group notifications','For group messages')
         + settingsToggleRow('notifCalls','Call notifications','For voice / video calls')
         + settingsToggleRow('ringtone','Call ringtone','Play a ringtone on incoming calls');
  } else if(name==='privacy'){
    html = settingsToggleRow('lastSeen','Last seen','Show your last seen')
         + settingsToggleRow('profilePhoto','Profile photo','Visible to contacts only')
         + settingsToggleRow('readReceipts','Read receipts','Send and show blue ticks')
         + `<div class="section-label">Blocked contacts</div><div id="blockedList">${blockedHTML()}</div>
            <div class="set-note">Choose from below to block a contact.</div>
            <div class="set-form"><select id="blockPick" style="padding:12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text);font:inherit">${CONTACTS.length ? CONTACTS.map(n=>`<option>${esc(n)}</option>`).join('') : `<option value="">No contacts</option>`}</select><button class="btn btn-ghost" id="blockAdd">Block contact</button></div>`;
  } else if(name==='chats'){
    html = `<div class="section-label">Wallpaper</div>
      <div class="wp-grid">${Object.keys(WALLPAPERS).map(k=>`<button class="wp" data-wp="${k}"><span class="wpbox" style="background:${WALLPAPERS[k]||'var(--surface-2)'}">${s.wallpaper===k?'<b>✓</b>':''}</span><em>${k}</em></button>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="section-label">Backup</div>
      <div class="set-form">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="exportBtn">Export backup (.json)</button>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="importBtn">Import backup</button>
        <input type="file" id="importFile" accept="application/json,.json" class="fileinput">
      </div>
      <div class="section-label">Storage</div>
      <div class="set-form">
        <div class="storage-info">${storageHTML()}</div>
        <button class="btn btn-danger" id="clearChatsBtn">Clear all chats</button>
      </div>`;
  } else if(name==='security'){
    html = `<div class="set-form">
      <div class="note-card">🔒 Cloud chats are end-to-end encrypted. Your private key is generated on and stays on this device; messages are locked before they leave it, so only you and your contact can read them. (Local-only chats never leave the phone.)<br><br>⚠️ Your key is saved in this browser's storage. If you <b>clear site data</b> or open the app in <b>incognito</b>, a <b>new key</b> is created and <b>older messages can no longer be read</b>. So use a normal (non-incognito) window and don't clear data.</div>
      <div class="set-note" style="padding:0">Encryption on this device: <b>${E2E.ready ? 'Active ✓' : 'Not set up'}</b>${E2E.ready ? '' : ' — open the app over HTTPS, then tap Set up.'}</div>
      ${E2E.ready ? '' : '<button class="btn btn-ghost" id="setupE2E">Set up encryption</button>'}
      <div class="field"><label>New password</label><input id="secPass" type="password" placeholder="New password"></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="savePass">Change password</button>
      <button class="btn btn-danger" id="wipeBtn">Erase all app data</button>
      <button class="btn btn-danger" id="deleteAcctBtn">Delete my account</button>
      <div class="set-note" style="padding:0">Permanently deletes your account and all associated data — profile, chats and encryption key. This cannot be undone.</div>
    </div>`;
  } else if(name==='backend'){
    const cfg = getFbConfig();
    html = `<div class="set-form">
      <div class="note-card">${fb.enabled?'✓ Firebase connected — real accounts (signup / login) are active.':'Firebase is not connected.'}</div>
      <div class="section-label">Media host (Cloudinary)</div>
      <div class="set-note" style="padding:0">Files (photo / video / pdf / any) are <b>encrypted on your device</b>, then uploaded to Cloudinary. Already <b>pre-configured</b> — change below only if needed.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Cloudinary cloud name</label><input id="clCloud" value="${esc((getCloudinary()||{}).cloud||'')}" placeholder="e.g. dxxxxxxx"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Unsigned upload preset</label><input id="clPreset" value="${esc((getCloudinary()||{}).preset||'')}" placeholder="e.g. pluto_unsigned"></div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="clSave">Save media host</button>
      <div class="set-note" style="padding:0">Media host: <b>${getCloudinary()?'Cloudinary ✓':'not set'}</b></div>
      <div class="set-note" style="padding:0">Status: <b>${fb.enabled?'Connected ✓':'Local mode (Firebase off)'}</b></div>
    </div>`;
  }
  body.innerHTML = html;
  bindSettingsSection(name);
}
function bindSettingsSection(name){
  const q = s=>document.querySelector(s);
  if(name==='profile'){
    const b=q('#saveProfile'); if(b) b.onclick=()=>{
      const nm=q('#pfName').value.trim()||'You', ab=q('#pfAbout').value.trim();
      const mob=q('#pfMobile').value.trim(), em=q('#pfEmail').value.trim(), mkey=mobileKeyOf(mob);
      state.user = Object.assign({}, state.user||{}, {name:nm, about:ab, mobile:mob, email:em});
      state.profile = Object.assign({}, state.profile||{}, {name:nm, about:ab});
      save();
      if(fb.enabled && fb.uid){ try{ fb.db.collection('users').doc(fb.uid).set({name:nm, nameLower:nm.toLowerCase(), about:ab, mobile:mob, mobileKey:mkey, email:em.toLowerCase()}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){} }
      renderMain(); toast('Profile saved');
    };
  }
  if(name==='privacy'){
    const ba=q('#blockAdd'); if(ba) ba.onclick=()=>{ const n=q('#blockPick').value; state.blocked=state.blocked||[]; if(n && !state.blocked.includes(n)){ state.blocked.push(n); save(); renderSettingsSection('privacy'); toast(n+' blocked'); } };
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-unblock]').forEach(x=> x.onclick=()=>{ state.blocked=(state.blocked||[]).filter(n=>n!==x.dataset.unblock); save(); renderSettingsSection('privacy'); toast('Unblocked'); });
  }
  if(name==='chats'){
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-wp]').forEach(x=> x.onclick=()=>{ state.settings.wallpaper=x.dataset.wp; save(); applySettings(); renderSettingsSection('chats'); });
    const ex=q('#exportBtn'); if(ex) ex.onclick=exportBackup;
    const im=q('#importBtn'); if(im) im.onclick=()=>q('#importFile').click();
    const inf=q('#importFile'); if(inf) inf.onchange=e=>{ const f=e.target.files[0]; e.target.value=''; if(f) importBackup(f); };
    const cc=q('#clearChatsBtn'); if(cc) cc.onclick=()=>{ if(confirm('Delete all chats? This cannot be undone.')){ deleteAllChats(); renderSettingsSection('chats'); } };
  }
  if(name==='security'){
    const se=q('#setupE2E'); if(se) se.onclick=async ()=>{ const ok=await e2eInit(fb.uid); if(ok){ toast('Encryption set up ✓'); renderSettingsSection('security'); } else { toast('Could not set up — open the app over HTTPS'); } };
    const sp=q('#savePass'); if(sp) sp.onclick=async ()=>{
      const p=q('#secPass').value;
      if(p.length<6){ toast('Password must be at least 6 characters'); return; }
      if(fb.enabled && fb.auth && fb.auth.currentUser){
        try{ await fb.auth.currentUser.updatePassword(p); toast('Password changed'); }
        catch(e){ toast(fbErrMsg(e)); }
        return;
      }
      try{ const acc=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pluto_account')||'null'); if(acc){ acc.salt=randSalt(); acc.ph=(await hashPass(p, acc.salt))||('plain:'+p); delete acc.pass; localStorage.setItem('pluto_account', JSON.stringify(acc)); toast('Password changed'); } else toast('Create an account first'); }catch(e){ toast('Password not saved'); }
    };
    const wb=q('#wipeBtn'); if(wb) wb.onclick=()=>{ if(confirm('Erase all app data? This cannot be undone.')){ try{ localStorage.removeItem('pluto_state'); localStorage.removeItem('pluto_account'); if(fb.uid) localStorage.removeItem('pluto_e2e_'+fb.uid); }catch(e){} location.reload(); } };
    const da=q('#deleteAcctBtn'); if(da) da.onclick=deleteAccount;
  }
  if(name==='backend'){
    const cfgEl=q('#fbCfg'); const cur=getFbConfig(); if(cfgEl && cur) cfgEl.value = JSON.stringify(cur, null, 2);
    const sv=q('#fbSave'); if(sv) sv.onclick=()=>{
      const raw=(q('#fbCfg').value||'').trim();
      if(!raw){ toast('Paste the config'); return; }
      let obj;
      try{ obj = JSON.parse(raw.replace(/^\s*(const|var|let)\s+\w+\s*=\s*/,'').replace(/;\s*$/,'')); }
      catch(e){ toast('Invalid JSON — copy the config again'); return; }
      if(!obj.apiKey || !obj.projectId){ toast('apiKey and projectId are required'); return; }
      setFbConfig(obj); toast('Saved — reloading…'); setTimeout(()=>location.reload(), 600);
    };
    const rm=q('#fbRemove'); if(rm) rm.onclick=()=>{ if(confirm('Remove Firebase config? The app will switch to local mode.')){ setFbConfig(null); location.reload(); } };
    const cs=q('#clSave'); if(cs) cs.onclick=()=>{
      const cloud=(q('#clCloud').value||'').trim(), preset=(q('#clPreset').value||'').trim();
      if(!cloud || !preset){ toast('Enter cloud name and preset'); return; }
      setCloudinary({cloud, preset}); toast('Media host saved'); renderSettingsSection('backend');
    };
  }
}
function exportBackup(){
  try{
    const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(state)],{type:'application/json'});
    const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download='pluto-backup.json'; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),3000);
    toast('Backup exported');
  }catch(e){ toast('Export fail'); }
}
function importBackup(file){
  const r=new FileReader();
  r.onload=()=>{ try{
    const obj=JSON.parse(r.result);
    if(obj && obj.chats){
      state=Object.assign({ chats:[], tab:'chats', user:null, blocked:[], settings:Object.assign({},DEFAULT_SETTINGS), profile:{} }, obj);
      state.settings=Object.assign({},DEFAULT_SETTINGS,obj.settings||{});
      if(!state.blocked) state.blocked=[];
      save(); applySettings(); renderMain(); closeSettingsSheet();
      toast('Backup restored');
    } else toast('File is not valid');
  }catch(e){ toast('Import failed — could not read the file'); } };
  r.readAsText(file);
}

/* ---------- Overflow menu + long-press actions ---------- */
let actionItems = [];
let lpTimer=null, lpTarget=null, lpFired=false;
function toggleMenu(force){ const m=$('#menuPop'); const show = force!==undefined?force:!m.classList.contains('show'); m.classList.toggle('show', show); }
function handleMenu(k){
  toggleMenu(false);
  if(k==='newgroup') openGroupSheet();
  else if(k==='starred') openStarSheet();
  else if(k==='archived') openArchSheet();
  else if(k==='markread'){ state.chats.forEach(c=>c.unread=0); save(); renderMain(); toast('All chats marked as read'); }
  else if(k==='settings'){ const t=document.querySelector('.tab[data-tab="settings"]'); if(t) t.click(); }
  else if(k==='help') openHelpSheet();
  else if(k==='privacy') openPrivacySheet();
  else if(k==='clear'){ if(confirm('Delete all chats? This cannot be undone.')){ deleteAllChats(); } }
}
function openActionSheet(title, items){
  $('#actionTitle').textContent = title;
  actionItems = items;
  $('#actionBody').innerHTML = items.map((it,i)=>`<button class="sheet-act ${it.danger?'danger':''}" data-act="${i}">${esc(it.label)}</button>`).join('');
  $('#actionSheet').style.display='flex';
}
function closeActionSheet(){ $('#actionSheet').style.display='none'; }
function lastTsOf(c){
  if(c.lastMsg && c.lastMsg.ts) return c.lastMsg.ts;
  const m = (c.msgs||[])[c.msgs.length-1];
  return (m && m.ts) || 0;
}
async function deleteChatCloud(c){
  if(!(c && c.cloud && fb.enabled && fb.uid)) return;
  try{
    const msgs = await fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).collection('messages').get();
    await Promise.all(msgs.docs.map(d=>d.ref.delete().catch(()=>{})));
  }catch(e){}
  try{ await fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).delete(); }catch(e){}
}
async function deleteChat(id){
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(c) await deleteChatCloud(c);
  state.chats = state.chats.filter(x=>x.id!==id);
  save(); renderMain(); toast('Chat deleted');
}
async function deleteAllChats(){
  const cloud = state.chats.filter(c=>c.cloud);
  await Promise.all(cloud.map(deleteChatCloud));
  state.chats = [];
  save(); renderMain(); toast('All chats cleared');
}
async function deleteMessage(c, m){
  if(c && c.cloud && m && typeof m.id==='string'){
    try{ await fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).collection('messages').doc(m.id).delete(); }catch(e){}
  }
  c.msgs = c.msgs.filter(x=>x!==m);
  save(); renderMessages(); renderMain(); toast('Message deleted');
}
async function playInlineVideo(m, el){
  if(!el || el.dataset.playing) return;
  el.dataset.playing = '1';
  const w = el.style.maxWidth || '240px';
  try{
    let url = null;
    if(m.url && m.iv){
      const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
      const peerPub = c ? (c.peerPub || await e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid)) : null;
      if(!peerPub){ toast('Encryption key not ready'); delete el.dataset.playing; return; }
      el.innerHTML = '<div style="width:'+w+';height:130px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-size:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);border-radius:10px">Loading…</div>';
      const r = await fetch(m.url); if(!r.ok) throw new Error('download failed');
      const pt = await decryptBytes(await r.arrayBuffer(), m.iv, peerPub);
      url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([pt], {type:m.mime||'video/mp4'}));
    } else {
      url = m.url || m.data;
      if(url && url.startsWith('data:')){ try{ url = URL.createObjectURL(await (await fetch(url)).blob()); }catch(e){} }
    }
    if(!url){ toast('Could not load video'); delete el.dataset.playing; return; }
    el.outerHTML = '<video src="'+url+'" controls autoplay playsinline style="width:'+w+';max-width:100%;border-radius:10px;display:block;background:#000"></video>';
  }catch(e){ toast('Could not play — '+(e.message||'')); try{ delete el.dataset.playing; }catch(_){} }
}
const shareCache = {};   // message id -> prepared File
async function buildShareFile(m){
  let blob=null; const name=m.name||('pluto-'+m.kind);
  if(m.url && m.iv){
    const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
    const peerPub = c ? (c.peerPub || await e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid)) : null;
    if(!peerPub) return null;
    const r = await fetch(m.url); if(!r.ok) return null;
    const pt = await decryptBytes(await r.arrayBuffer(), m.iv, peerPub);
    blob = new Blob([pt], {type:m.mime||'application/octet-stream'});
  } else {
    const u = m.url || m.data; if(!u) return null;
    blob = await (await fetch(u)).blob();
    if(m.mime && blob.type!==m.mime){ try{ blob = new Blob([blob], {type:m.mime}); }catch(e){} }
  }
  let file=null; try{ file = new File([blob], name, {type:m.mime||blob.type||'application/octet-stream'}); }catch(e){}
  if(file) shareCache[m.id] = file;
  return file;
}
function blobToB64(blob){ return new Promise((res,rej)=>{ const r=new FileReader(); r.onload=()=>res(String(r.result).split(',')[1]); r.onerror=rej; r.readAsDataURL(blob); }); }
async function nativeShareFile(file, name){
  /* In an APK WebView navigator.share does not exist. If the app was wrapped with
     Capacitor + the Share/Filesystem plugins, use those to open the native sheet. */
  try{
    const Cap = window.Capacitor;
    const FS = Cap && Cap.Plugins && Cap.Plugins.Filesystem;
    const Sh = Cap && Cap.Plugins && Cap.Plugins.Share;
    if(!FS || !Sh) return false;
    const b64 = await blobToB64(file);
    const saved = await FS.writeFile({ path: name, data: b64, directory: 'CACHE' });
    if(saved && saved.uri){ await Sh.share({ files:[saved.uri], title:name }); return true; }
  }catch(e){}
  return false;
}
function prepareShareFile(m){        // warm the file while the menu is open
  if(!m || !['image','video','file','voice'].includes(m.kind) || shareCache[m.id]) return;
  buildShareFile(m).catch(()=>{});
}
async function shareMessage(m){
  if(!m) return;
  try{
    if(['image','video','file','voice'].includes(m.kind)){
      const name=m.name||('pluto-'+m.kind);
      let file = shareCache[m.id] || null;
      if(!file){ toast('Preparing…'); file = await buildShareFile(m); }
      // call share() right away so the tap gesture is still valid
      if(file && navigator.share && navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({files:[file]})){
        await navigator.share({ files:[file], title:name }); return;
      }
      if(file && navigator.share){ try{ await navigator.share({ files:[file], title:name }); return; }catch(e){ if(e&&e.name==='AbortError') return; } }
      if(file && await nativeShareFile(file, name)){ return; }   // APK (Capacitor) bridge
      if(file){
        const u2=URL.createObjectURL(file); const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=u2; a.download=name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
        setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u2), 30000);
        toast('Saved to your device — open Gallery / Files and share from there');
      } else toast('Sharing not supported here');
      return;
    }
    const txt = m.text || '';
    if(navigator.share){ await navigator.share({ text:txt }); return; }
    try{ await navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt); toast('Copied to clipboard'); }catch(e){ toast('Sharing not supported here'); }
  }catch(e){ if(e && e.name==='AbortError') return; toast('Could not share — '+(e.message||'')); }
}
function chatActions(id){
  const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===id); if(!c) return;
  openActionSheet(c.name, [
    {label: c.pinned?'Unpin chat':'Pin chat', fn:()=>{ c.pinned=!c.pinned; save(); renderMain(); closeActionSheet(); toast(c.pinned?'Pinned':'Unpinned'); }},
    {label: c.archived?'Unarchive chat':'Archive chat', fn:()=>{ c.archived=!c.archived; save(); renderMain(); closeActionSheet(); toast(c.archived?'Archived':'Unarchived'); }},
    {label:'Mark as read', fn:()=>{ c.unread=0; save(); renderMain(); closeActionSheet(); }},
    {label:'Report & block', danger:true, fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); reportContact(c.name); }},
    {label:'Delete chat', danger:true, fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); deleteChat(id); }}
  ]);
}
function msgActions(id){
  const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); if(!c) return;
  const m=c.msgs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id)); if(!m) return;
  try{ prepareShareFile(m); }catch(e){}
  const items = [
    {label:'Forward', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); openForwardSheet(m); }},
    {label:'Share to other apps', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); shareMessage(m); }},
    {label: m.starred?'Unstar message':'Star message', fn:()=>{ m.starred=!m.starred; save(); renderMessages(); closeActionSheet(); toast(m.starred?'Starred':'Unstarred'); }}
  ];
  if(['image','video','file','voice'].includes(m.kind)) items.push({label:'Save to device', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); openMedia(m); }});
  items.push({label:'Delete message', danger:true, fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); deleteMessage(c, m); }});
  openActionSheet('Message', items);
}
let selIds = [];
function inSelect(){ return selIds.length>0; }
function selectedMsgs(){ const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); if(!c) return []; return c.msgs.filter(m=>selIds.indexOf(String(m.id))>=0); }
function updateSelBar(){
  const bar=document.getElementById('selBar'); if(!bar) return;
  const hd=document.querySelector('#chatView .chat-header');
  if(selIds.length){ bar.style.display='flex'; if(hd) hd.style.display='none'; const cc=document.getElementById('selCount'); if(cc) cc.textContent=String(selIds.length); }
  else { bar.style.display='none'; if(hd) hd.style.display=''; }
}
function enterSelect(id){
  if(!activeChatId) return;
  selIds=[String(id)]; updateSelBar(); renderMessages();
  const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  const m=c && c.msgs.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));
  const el=document.querySelector('.msg[data-msg="'+id+'"]');
  if(m && el) showMsgPop(m, el);
}
function toggleSelect(id){ id=String(id); const i=selIds.indexOf(id); if(i>=0) selIds.splice(i,1); else selIds.push(id); if(!selIds.length){ exitSelect(); return; } updateSelBar(); renderMessages(); }
function exitSelect(){ selIds=[]; hideMsgPop(); updateSelBar(); renderMessages(); }
function selStar(){ const ms=selectedMsgs(); if(!ms.length) return; const on=!ms.every(m=>m.starred); ms.forEach(m=>m.starred=on); save(); renderMessages(); toast(on?'Starred':'Unstarred'); }
function selDelete(){
  const c=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); const ms=selectedMsgs(); if(!c||!ms.length) return;
  if(!confirm('Delete '+ms.length+' message'+(ms.length>1?'s':'')+'?')) return;
  ms.forEach(m=>{ const i=c.msgs.indexOf(m); if(i>=0) c.msgs.splice(i,1); });
  exitSelect(); save(); renderMessages(); renderMain(); toast('Deleted');
}
function selForward(){ const ms=selectedMsgs(); if(!ms.length) return; openForwardSheet(ms); }
function selMore(){
  const ms=selectedMsgs(); if(!ms.length) return;
  const one = ms.length===1 ? ms[0] : null; const items=[];
  if(one && one.text){ items.push({label:'Copy text', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); copyText(one.text); }}); }
  if(one && ['image','video','file','voice'].includes(one.kind)){
    items.push({label:'Share to other apps', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); shareMessage(one); }});
    items.push({label:'Save to device', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); openMedia(one); }});
  }
  items.push({label:'Star / Unstar', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); selStar(); }});
  openActionSheet(ms.length+' selected', items);
}
function copyText(txt){
  txt = String(txt==null?'':txt);
  if(!txt){ toast('Nothing to copy'); return; }
  const ok = ()=>toast('Copied');
  try{
    if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(ok).catch(()=>legacyCopy(txt, ok));
      return;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  legacyCopy(txt, ok);
}
function legacyCopy(txt, ok){
  try{
    const ta=document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value=txt; ta.setAttribute('readonly',''); ta.style.position='fixed'; ta.style.top='-1000px'; ta.style.opacity='0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.focus(); ta.select();
    const done=document.execCommand('copy'); ta.remove();
    if(done) ok(); else toast('Copy not supported here');
  }catch(e){ toast('Copy not supported here'); }
}
function hideMsgPop(){ const p=document.getElementById('msgPop'); if(p) p.classList.remove('show'); }
function showMsgPop(m, el){
  const pop=document.getElementById('msgPop'); if(!pop || !m) return;
  const items=[];
  if(m.text) items.push({k:'copy', label:'Copy'});
  items.push({k:'star', label: m.starred?'Unstar':'Star'});
  items.push({k:'more', label:'More'});
  pop.innerHTML = items.map(it=>'<button data-msgpop="'+it.k+'">'+it.label+'</button>').join('');
  pop._m = m;
  pop.classList.add('show');
  try{
    const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w=pop.offsetWidth||170, h=pop.offsetHeight||40;
    let top=r.top-h-8; if(top<8) top=r.bottom+8;
    let left=r.left; const maxL=(window.innerWidth||360)-w-8; if(left>maxL) left=maxL; if(left<8) left=8;
    pop.style.top=top+'px'; pop.style.left=left+'px';
  }catch(e){}
}
function handleMsgPop(k, m){
  hideMsgPop();
  if(!m) return;
  if(k==='copy') copyText(m.text);
  else if(k==='star'){ m.starred=!m.starred; save(); renderMessages(); toast(m.starred?'Starred':'Unstarred'); }
  else if(k==='more'){ selMore(); }
}
function tryOpenExternal(url){
  if(!url) return false;
  // native bridges, if the APK wrapper provides one
  try{ if(window.Capacitor && Capacitor.Plugins && Capacitor.Plugins.Browser){ Capacitor.Plugins.Browser.open({url:url}); return true; } }catch(e){}
  try{ if(window.ReactNativeWebView && window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage){ window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage(JSON.stringify({type:'openUrl', url:url})); return true; } }catch(e){}
  try{ if(window.Android && typeof window.Android.openUrl==='function'){ window.Android.openUrl(url); return true; } }catch(e){}
  try{ if(window.AndroidBridge && typeof window.AndroidBridge.openUrl==='function'){ window.AndroidBridge.openUrl(url); return true; } }catch(e){}
  // new tab / external window (does NOT navigate the current page)
  try{ const w=window.open(url,'_blank','noopener'); if(w) return true; }catch(e){}
  return false;
}
function showLinkSheet(url){
  openActionSheet('Link', [
    {label:'Open in browser', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); tryOpenExternal(url); }},
    {label:'Copy link', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); copyText(url); }}
  ]);
}
function lpStart(e){
  const row=e.target.closest('[data-chat]'); const msg=e.target.closest('.msg[data-msg]'); const crow=e.target.closest('[data-callrow]');
  if(!row && !msg && !crow) return;
  lpTarget = crow ? {type:'call', id:crow.dataset.callrow} : (row ? {type:'chat', id:row.dataset.chat} : {type:'msg', id:msg.dataset.msg});
  clearTimeout(lpTimer);
  lpTimer=setTimeout(()=>{ lpTimer=null; if(lpTarget){ lpFired=true; setTimeout(()=>{lpFired=false;},700); if(lpTarget.type==='chat') chatActions(lpTarget.id); else if(lpTarget.type==='call') callRowActions(lpTarget.id); else enterSelect(lpTarget.id); lpTarget=null; } }, 550);
}
function lpEnd(){ if(lpTimer){ clearTimeout(lpTimer); lpTimer=null; } lpTarget=null; }
document.addEventListener('touchstart', lpStart, {passive:true});
document.addEventListener('touchend', lpEnd);
document.addEventListener('touchmove', lpEnd, {passive:true});
document.addEventListener('mousedown', lpStart);
document.addEventListener('mouseup', lpEnd);
document.addEventListener('contextmenu', e=>{
  const row=e.target.closest('[data-chat]'); const msg=e.target.closest('.msg[data-msg]'); const crow=e.target.closest('[data-callrow]');
  if(row||msg||crow){ e.preventDefault(); if(crow) callRowActions(crow.dataset.callrow); else if(row) chatActions(row.dataset.chat); else enterSelect(msg.dataset.msg); }
});
function openGroupSheet(){
  const body=$('#groupBody');
  body.innerHTML = `<div class="set-form"><div class="field"><label>Group name</label><input id="grpName" placeholder="e.g. College Friends"></div></div>
    <div class="section-label">Select members</div>
    ${CONTACTS.length ? CONTACTS.map(n=>`<label class="grp-row"><input type="checkbox" value="${esc(n)}"><span>${esc(n)}</span></label>`).join('') : `<div class="set-note">No contacts yet.</div>`}
    <div class="set-form"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="grpCreate">Create group</button></div>`;
  const b=$('#grpCreate'); if(b) b.onclick=createGroup;
  $('#groupSheet').style.display='flex';
}
function createGroup(){
  const name=($('#grpName').value||'').trim() || 'New group';
  const members=[...document.querySelectorAll('#groupBody input[type=checkbox]:checked')].map(x=>x.value);
  if(!members.length){ toast('Choose at least one member'); return; }
  const c={ id:'g'+now(), name, pinned:false, unread:0, isGroup:true, members, msgs:[ {id:now(), from:'them', text:'Group "'+name+'" created 👋', ts:now(), sender:members[0]} ] };
  state.chats.unshift(c); save();
  $('#groupSheet').style.display='none';
  renderMain(); openChat(c.id); toast('Group created');
}
function openStarSheet(){
  const body=$('#starBody'); const items=[];
  state.chats.forEach(c=>c.msgs.forEach(m=>{ if(m.starred) items.push({c,m}); }));
  items.sort((a,b)=>b.m.ts-a.m.ts);
  const kindTxt = m => m.kind ? ({image:'📷 Photo',video:'🎥 Video',file:'📄 '+(m.name||'Document'),voice:'🎤 Voice message',location:(m.live?'📍 Live location':'📍 Location')}[m.kind]||'') : m.text;
  if(!items.length) body.innerHTML = emptyHTML('No starred messages. Long-press a message to star it.','star');
  else body.innerHTML = items.map(({c,m})=>`<div class="star-row" data-star-chat="${c.id}"><div class="who">${esc(c.name)}</div><div class="txt2">${esc(kindTxt(m))}</div><div class="when">${fmt(m.ts)}</div></div>`).join('');
  $('#starSheet').style.display='flex';
}
function openArchSheet(){
  const body=$('#archBody'); const list=state.chats.filter(c=>c.archived);
  if(!list.length) body.innerHTML = emptyHTML('No archived chats.','arch');
  else body.innerHTML = list.map(c=>`<div class="blocked-row"><div class="t">${esc(c.name)}</div><button class="ub" data-unarch="${c.id}">Unarchive</button></div>`).join('');
  $('#archSheet').style.display='flex';
}
function openHelpSheet(){
  $('#helpBody').innerHTML = `<div class="set-form">
    <div class="note-card">Pluto — simple, private messaging.</div>
    <div class="set-note" style="padding:0">
      <b>New chat:</b> via the + button, or by tapping a contact.<br><br>
      <b>Long-press</b> a chat → Pin / Archive / Delete.<br><br>
      <b>Long-press</b> a message → Forward / Star / Delete.<br><br>
      <b>Attach (📎):</b> Photos, Document, Camera, Voice message, Location.<br><br>
      <b>Live location:</b> inside a chat, 📎 → Location → choose a duration.<br><br>
      <b>Permissions:</b> allow everything from Settings → Permissions.
    </div>
  </div>`;
  $('#helpSheet').style.display='flex';
}
function openPrivacySheet(){
  $('#privacyBody').innerHTML = `<div class="set-form">
    <div class="note-card">Pluto — Privacy Policy</div>
    <div class="set-note" style="padding:0">
      <b>What we collect:</b> your name, mobile number and email when you create an account; the messages, photos, documents, voice notes and location you choose to send; and basic device/technical data needed to run the app.<br><br>
      <b>How it is stored:</b> for cloud accounts, account and chat data are stored in Google Firebase (Authentication + Firestore). Cloud messages are end-to-end encrypted, so the message content is not readable by the server. Local-only chats never leave your device.<br><br>
      <b>How we use it:</b> only to provide the messaging, calling and stories features. We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.<br><br>
      <b>Sharing:</b> data is shared only with Google Firebase (our hosting/backend provider) to operate the service, and with the contacts you message.<br><br>
      <b>Permissions:</b> camera, microphone, location, files and notifications are requested only when you use the matching feature, and can be turned off in your device settings.<br><br>
      <b>Your choices:</b> you can edit your profile, block or report contacts, export a backup, and <b>delete your account and all data</b> at any time from Settings → Security → Delete my account.<br><br>
      <b>Children:</b> Pluto is not intended for children under 13.<br><br>
      <b>Contact:</b> for any privacy request, email ncrsiyaram@zohomail.in.
    </div>
  </div>`;
  $('#privacySheet').style.display='flex';
}
async function deleteAccount(){
  if(!confirm('Delete your account permanently? All your chats, profile and encryption key will be erased. This cannot be undone.')) return;
  if(fb.enabled && fb.auth && fb.auth.currentUser){
    try{
      const uid = fb.auth.currentUser.uid;
      try{
        const chats = await fb.db.collection('chats').where('members','array-contains', uid).get();
        for(const doc of chats.docs){ try{ await doc.ref.delete(); }catch(e){} }
      }catch(e){}
      try{ await fb.db.collection('users').doc(uid).delete(); }catch(e){}
      await fb.auth.currentUser.delete();
    }catch(e){ toast('Could not delete account: '+fbErrMsg(e)); return; }
  }
  try{
    localStorage.removeItem('pluto_state');
    localStorage.removeItem('pluto_account');
    localStorage.removeItem('pluto_e2e');
    if(fb.uid) localStorage.removeItem('pluto_e2e_'+fb.uid);
  }catch(e){}
  state.user=null; state.chats=[]; try{ save(); }catch(e){}
  toast('Your account has been deleted');
  setTimeout(()=>location.reload(), 800);
}
function reportContact(name){
  if(!name) return;
  if(!confirm('Report "'+name+'" for abuse and block this contact?')) return;
  state.blocked = state.blocked||[];
  if(!state.blocked.includes(name)) state.blocked.push(name);
  try{ save(); }catch(e){}
  try{
    const body = encodeURIComponent('I want to report the contact: '+name+'\nReason: ');
    window.location.href = 'mailto:ncrsiyaram@zohomail.in?subject='+encodeURIComponent('Pluto — abuse report')+'&body='+body;
  }catch(e){}
  renderMain(); toast(name+' reported and blocked');
}

/* ---------- Stories engine ---------- */
const STORY_BGS = ['#0d7d74','#3d6bb3','#c0504d','#8e5bb5','#b5651d','#2a9d8f'];
let svGroup=null, svIdx=0, svTimer=null;
function ago(ts){ const s=Math.max(0,Math.floor((now()-ts)/1000)); if(s<60) return 'just now'; const m=Math.floor(s/60); if(m<60) return m+'m ago'; const h=Math.floor(m/60); if(h<24) return h+'h ago'; return Math.floor(h/24)+'d ago'; }
function storyList(){ return state.stories.filter(s=>s.mine&&s.items.length).concat(state.stories.filter(s=>!s.mine&&s.items.length)); }
function openStory(id){
  const s = state.stories.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!s || (s.mine && !s.items.length)){ openStorySheet(); return; }
  svGroup = s; svIdx = 0;
  $('#storyView').classList.add('show');
  renderStoryFrame();
}
function renderStoryFrame(){
  const s = svGroup; if(!s || !s.items.length) return;
  const item = s.items[svIdx];
  $('#svAvatar').textContent = INI(s.name); $('#svAvatar').style.background = AV(s.name);
  $('#svName').textContent = s.mine ? 'My story' : s.name;
  $('#svTime').textContent = ago(item.ts);
  const taps = `<div class="sv-tap left" id="svPrev"></div><div class="sv-tap right" id="svNext"></div>`;
  const body = $('#svBody');
  if(item.kind==='image') body.innerHTML = `<img src="${item.data}" alt="story">`+taps+(item.caption?`<div class="sv-cap">${esc(item.caption)}</div>`:'');
  else body.innerHTML = `<div class="stext" style="background:${item.bg||'#0d7d74'}">${esc(item.text||'')}</div>`+taps;
  $('#svBars').innerHTML = s.items.map((_,i)=>`<span class="svseg ${i<svIdx?'done':''} ${i===svIdx?'active':''}"><i></i></span>`).join('');
  $('#svPrev').onclick = (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); storyPrev(); };
  $('#svNext').onclick = (e)=>{ e.stopPropagation(); storyNext(); };
  clearTimeout(svTimer); svTimer = setTimeout(storyNext, 5000);
}
function storyNext(){
  const s = svGroup; if(!s) return;
  if(svIdx < s.items.length-1){ svIdx++; renderStoryFrame(); return; }
  s.seen = true; save();
  const list = storyList(); const i = list.indexOf(s);
  const nxt = (i>=0 && i<list.length-1) ? list[i+1] : null;
  if(nxt){ svGroup = nxt; svIdx = 0; renderStoryFrame(); } else closeStory();
}
function storyPrev(){
  if(svIdx>0){ svIdx--; renderStoryFrame(); return; }
  const list = storyList(); const i = list.indexOf(svGroup);
  const prev = (i>0) ? list[i-1] : null;
  if(prev){ svGroup = prev; svIdx = prev.items.length-1; renderStoryFrame(); }
}
function closeStory(){ clearTimeout(svTimer); svTimer=null; $('#storyView').classList.remove('show'); svGroup=null; renderMain(); }
function openStorySheet(){
  const body=$('#storyBody');
  body.innerHTML = `<div class="story-add">
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="stCam">📷  Camera</button>
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="stGal">🖼️  Gallery</button>
    <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="stTxt">✍️  Text</button>
  </div>`;
  const c=$('#stCam'), g=$('#stGal'), t=$('#stTxt');
  if(c) c.onclick=()=>{ $('#storySheet').style.display='none'; cameraTarget='story'; openCamera(); };
  if(g) g.onclick=()=>$('#storyPhoto').click();
  if(t) t.onclick=()=>{ const x=prompt('Story text likhein:'); if(x && x.trim()){ addStoryItem({kind:'text', text:x.trim(), bg:STORY_BGS[Math.floor(Math.random()*STORY_BGS.length)]}); $('#storySheet').style.display='none'; } };
  $('#storySheet').style.display='flex';
}
function myStory(){
  let s = state.stories.find(x=>x.mine);
  if(!s){ s = {id:'me', name:(state.user&&state.user.name)||'You', mine:true, seen:false, items:[]}; state.stories.unshift(s); }
  return s;
}
function addStoryItem(item){
  const s = myStory();
  s.items.push(Object.assign({id:now()+Math.random(), ts:now()}, item));
  s.seen = false;
  save(); renderMain(); toast('Story added');
}

/* ---------- Real 1:1 calls (WebRTC, signaled over Firestore) ---------- */
let rtc = null;
let incomingUnsub = null;
let pendingIncoming = null;
/* STUN helps two devices find a direct path. TURN relays the (still encrypted)
   media when a direct path is impossible — needed on most mobile networks
   (Jio/Airtel use CGNAT / symmetric NAT).
   >>> For reliable production calls, replace the public demo relay below with
   YOUR OWN TURN server (Metered / Twilio / your own coturn) in TURN_SERVERS. */
const TURN_SERVERS = [
  // { urls:'turn:YOUR_TURN_HOST:3478', username:'YOUR_USER', credential:'YOUR_PASS' },
  // { urls:'turn:YOUR_TURN_HOST:443?transport=tcp', username:'YOUR_USER', credential:'YOUR_PASS' },
  // Public demo relay — free & best-effort (credentials are published by the provider for public use, not secret):
  { urls:'turn:openrelay.metered.ca:80', username:'openrelayproject', credential:'openrelayproject' },
  { urls:'turn:openrelay.metered.ca:443', username:'openrelayproject', credential:'openrelayproject' },
  { urls:'turn:openrelay.metered.ca:443?transport=tcp', username:'openrelayproject', credential:'openrelayproject' }
];
const RTC_CONFIG = { iceServers: [
  { urls:'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' },
  { urls:'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302' }
].concat(TURN_SERVERS) };
function rtcSupported(){ return !!(window.RTCPeerConnection && navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia); }
function rtcLocalMedia(video){
  return navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
    video: video ? { facingMode:'user', width:{ideal:1280}, height:{ideal:720} } : false,
    audio: { echoCancellation:true, noiseSuppression:true, autoGainControl:true }
  });
}
function showCallUI(name, video, status){
  const cs=$('#callScreen'); cs.classList.add('show'); cs.classList.toggle('video', !!video);
  $('#csAvatar').textContent=INI(name); $('#csAvatar').style.background=AV(name);
  $('#csName').textContent=name; $('#csStatus').textContent=status||'Calling…';
  $('#csMute').classList.remove('active'); $('#csSpk').classList.remove('active'); $('#csCam').classList.toggle('active', !!video);
  const v=$('#csVideo'); if(v){ v.classList.remove('on','pip'); v.srcObject=null; }
  const r=$('#csRemote'); if(r){ r.classList.remove('on'); r.srcObject=null; }
  const ra=$('#csRemoteAudio'); if(ra){ ra.srcObject=null; }
}
function attachLocalPreview(stream, video){
  const v=$('#csVideo'); if(!v) return;
  v.srcObject = stream;
  if(video){ v.classList.add('on','pip'); v.play().catch(()=>{}); } else { v.classList.remove('on','pip'); }
}
function rtcNewPeer(id){
  const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(RTC_CONFIG);
  pc.onicecandidate = (e)=>{ if(e.candidate && fb.uid){ try{ fb.db.collection('calls').doc(id).collection('candidates').add({ from: fb.uid, c: e.candidate.toJSON(), ts: Date.now() }); }catch(_){} } };
  pc.ontrack = (e)=>{
    const rs = e.streams[0] || new MediaStream([e.track]);
    const rv=$('#csRemote'); if(rv){ rv.srcObject=rs; rv.play().catch(()=>{}); if(rtc && rtc.video) rv.classList.add('on'); }
    const ra=$('#csRemoteAudio'); if(ra){ ra.srcObject=rs; ra.play().catch(()=>{}); }
    if(rtc) rtc.remoteStream = rs;
  };
  pc.onconnectionstatechange = ()=>{ if(pc.connectionState==='connected') rtcOnConnected(); };
  return pc;
}
function rtcAddCand(c){
  if(!rtc || !rtc.pc) return;
  if(rtc.pc.remoteDescription){ try{ rtc.pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)); }catch(e){} }
  else { (rtc.pendingCands = rtc.pendingCands||[]).push(c); }
}
function rtcFlushCands(){ if(rtc && rtc.pendingCands){ rtc.pendingCands.forEach(c=>{ try{ rtc.pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(c)); }catch(e){} }); rtc.pendingCands=[]; } }
function rtcWatchCands(id){
  if(rtc.unsubCand){ try{rtc.unsubCand();}catch(e){} }
  rtc.unsubCand = fb.db.collection('calls').doc(id).collection('candidates').onSnapshot((snap)=>{
    snap.forEach(doc=>{ const d=doc.data()||{}; if(d.from===fb.uid) return; if(d.c) rtcAddCand(d.c); });
  }, ()=>{});
}
function rtcWatchCall(id){
  if(rtc.unsubCall){ try{rtc.unsubCall();}catch(e){} }
  rtc.unsubCall = fb.db.collection('calls').doc(id).onSnapshot(async (doc)=>{
    const d = doc.data()||{}; if(!rtc) return;
    if(rtc.role==='caller' && d.answer && rtc.pc && !rtc.pc.currentRemoteDescription){
      try{ await rtc.pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(d.answer)); rtcFlushCands(); }catch(e){}
    }
    if(d.state==='accepted' && rtc.role==='caller') stopRingtone();
    if(d.state==='rejected'){ toast('Call declined'); rtcCleanup(); }
    else if(d.state==='ended'){ rtcCleanup(); }
  }, ()=>{});
}
async function startCloudCall(peerUid, name, video){
  if(rtc || !fb.enabled || !fb.uid) return;
  if(!rtcSupported()){ toast('Calls are not supported in this browser'); return; }
  const id = [fb.uid, peerUid].sort().join('_') + '_' + Date.now();
  rtc = { id, role:'caller', peerUid, name, video:!!video, pc:null, connected:false, started:0, timer:null, muted:false, spk:false };
  showCallUI(name, video, 'Calling…');
  startRingtone();
  try{
    const stream = await rtcLocalMedia(!!video); if(!rtc){ stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); return; }
    rtc.localStream = stream; attachLocalPreview(stream, !!video);
    const pc = rtcNewPeer(id); rtc.pc = pc;
    stream.getTracks().forEach(t=> pc.addTrack(t, stream));
    const offer = await pc.createOffer(); await pc.setLocalDescription(offer);
    await fb.db.collection('calls').doc(id).set({ from: fb.uid, to: peerUid, fromName:(state.user&&state.user.name)||'User', type: video?'video':'audio', state:'ringing', offer:{ type:offer.type, sdp:offer.sdp }, createdAt: Date.now(), updatedAt: Date.now() });
    rtcWatchCall(id); rtcWatchCands(id);
  }catch(e){ toast('Could not start call: '+((e&&e.message)||e)); rtcCleanup(); }
}
function pickRinging(snap){
  let found=null;
  snap.forEach(doc=>{ const d=doc.data()||{}; if(d.state==='ringing' && (Date.now()-(d.createdAt||0))<60000){ if(!found || (d.createdAt||0)>(found.d.createdAt||0)) found={id:doc.id, d}; } });
  return found;
}
function checkIncomingCalls(){
  if(!fb.enabled || !fb.uid || rtc) return;
  fb.db.collection('calls').where('to','==',fb.uid).get().then((snap)=>{
    const found = pickRinging(snap);
    if(found) showIncoming(found.id, found.d);
    else if(pendingIncoming) hideIncoming();
  }).catch((err)=>{ if(!checkIncomingCalls._e){ checkIncomingCalls._e=true; toast('Call check error: '+((err&&err.message)||err)); } });
}
function startCallListener(){
  if(!fb.enabled || !fb.uid) return;
  if(incomingUnsub){ try{incomingUnsub();}catch(e){} }
  incomingUnsub = fb.db.collection('calls').where('to','==',fb.uid).onSnapshot((snap)=>{
    if(rtc) return;
    const found = pickRinging(snap);
    if(found) showIncoming(found.id, found.d); else hideIncoming();
  }, (err)=>{ if(!startCallListener._e){ startCallListener._e=true; toast('Call listener error: '+((err&&err.message)||err)); } });
  checkIncomingCalls();
}
function stopCallListener(){ if(incomingUnsub){ try{incomingUnsub();}catch(e){} incomingUnsub=null; } }
/* poll as a safety net (missed snapshots / app just came back) */
setInterval(()=>{ if(document.visibilityState==='visible') checkIncomingCalls(); }, 5000);
function showIncoming(id, d){
  pendingIncoming = { id, from:d.from, name:d.fromName||'Contact', video:d.type==='video', offer:d.offer };
  $('#icAvatar').textContent = INI(pendingIncoming.name); $('#icAvatar').style.background = AV(pendingIncoming.name);
  $('#icName').textContent = pendingIncoming.name;
  $('#icType').textContent = pendingIncoming.video ? 'Incoming video call' : 'Incoming voice call';
  $('#incomingCall').classList.add('show');
  startRingtone(true);
}
function hideIncoming(){ $('#incomingCall').classList.remove('show'); pendingIncoming=null; stopRingtone(); }
async function acceptIncoming(){
  const inc = pendingIncoming; if(!inc) return;
  stopRingtone(); $('#incomingCall').classList.remove('show'); pendingIncoming=null;
  if(!rtcSupported() || !inc.offer){ try{ fb.db.collection('calls').doc(inc.id).set({state:'rejected',updatedAt:Date.now()},{merge:true}); }catch(e){} toast('Cannot answer this call'); return; }
  rtc = { id:inc.id, role:'callee', peerUid:inc.from, name:inc.name, video:!!inc.video, pc:null, connected:false, started:0, timer:null, muted:false, spk:false };
  showCallUI(inc.name, inc.video, 'Connecting…');
  try{
    const stream = await rtcLocalMedia(!!inc.video); if(!rtc){ stream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); return; }
    rtc.localStream = stream; attachLocalPreview(stream, !!inc.video);
    const pc = rtcNewPeer(inc.id); rtc.pc = pc;
    stream.getTracks().forEach(t=> pc.addTrack(t, stream));
    await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(inc.offer));
    const answer = await pc.createAnswer(); await pc.setLocalDescription(answer);
    await fb.db.collection('calls').doc(inc.id).set({ state:'accepted', answer:{ type:answer.type, sdp:answer.sdp }, updatedAt: Date.now() }, {merge:true});
    rtcWatchCall(inc.id); rtcWatchCands(inc.id); rtcFlushCands();
  }catch(e){ toast('Could not answer: '+((e&&e.message)||e)); try{ fb.db.collection('calls').doc(inc.id).set({state:'rejected',updatedAt:Date.now()},{merge:true}); }catch(_){} rtcCleanup(); }
}
function rejectIncoming(){
  if(pendingIncoming){ try{ fb.db.collection('calls').doc(pendingIncoming.id).set({state:'rejected', updatedAt:Date.now()},{merge:true}); }catch(e){} }
  hideIncoming();
}
function rtcOnConnected(){
  if(!rtc || rtc.connected) return;
  stopRingtone();
  rtc.connected=true; rtc.started=Date.now();
  $('#csStatus').textContent='00:00';
  rtc.timer=setInterval(()=>{ if(rtc) $('#csStatus').textContent = fmtDur(Math.floor((Date.now()-rtc.started)/1000)); }, 500);
}
function rtcCleanup(){
  if(!rtc) return;
  const r = rtc; rtc = null;
  stopRingtone();
  try{ if(r.unsubCall) r.unsubCall(); }catch(e){}
  try{ if(r.unsubCand) r.unsubCand(); }catch(e){}
  clearInterval(r.timer);
  try{ if(r.pc) r.pc.close(); }catch(e){}
  try{ if(r.localStream) r.localStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); }catch(e){}
  const rv=$('#csRemote'); if(rv){ rv.srcObject=null; rv.classList.remove('on'); }
  const ra=$('#csRemoteAudio'); if(ra){ ra.srcObject=null; }
  const lv=$('#csVideo'); if(lv){ lv.srcObject=null; lv.classList.remove('on','pip'); }
  $('#callScreen').classList.remove('show');
  const dur = r.connected ? Math.floor((Date.now()-r.started)/1000) : 0;
  logCall(r.name, r.role==='caller'?'out':'in', r.video, dur);
  toast(r.connected ? 'Call ended · '+fmtDur(dur) : 'Call ended');
  renderMain();
}

/* ---------- Calls engine ---------- */
let call = null;
function fmtDur(s){ s=Math.max(0,Math.round(s)); const m=Math.floor(s/60), ss=s%60; return m+':'+String(ss).padStart(2,'0'); }
function callWhen(ts){
  const d=new Date(ts), n=new Date(), y=new Date(n.getTime()-86400000);
  if(d.toDateString()===n.toDateString()) return fmt(ts);
  if(d.toDateString()===y.toDateString()) return 'Yesterday, '+fmt(ts);
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{day:'numeric',month:'short'})+' '+fmt(ts);
}
function startCall(name, video){
  const ac = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId);
  if(ac && ac.cloud && ac.peerUid && fb.enabled && fb.uid){ startCloudCall(ac.peerUid, name, video); return; }
  if(call) return;
  call = {name, video:!!video, started:0, timer:null, connectTimer:null, connected:false, muted:false, spk:false, mediaStream:null};
  const cs=$('#callScreen'); cs.classList.add('show'); cs.classList.toggle('video', !!video);
  $('#csAvatar').textContent=INI(name); $('#csAvatar').style.background=AV(name);
  $('#csName').textContent=name; $('#csStatus').textContent='Calling…';
  $('#csMute').classList.remove('active'); $('#csSpk').classList.remove('active'); $('#csCam').classList.toggle('active', !!video);
  startCallMedia(!!video);
  startRingtone();
  call.connectTimer = setTimeout(()=>{
    if(!call) return;
    stopRingtone();
    call.connected=true; call.started=Date.now(); $('#csStatus').textContent='00:00';
    call.timer=setInterval(()=>{ if(call) $('#csStatus').textContent = fmtDur(Math.floor((Date.now()-call.started)/1000)); }, 500);
  }, 2200);
}
async function startCallMedia(video){
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) return;
  try{
    const s = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: video ? {facingMode:'user', width:{ideal:1280}, height:{ideal:720}, frameRate:{ideal:30}} : false,
      audio: {echoCancellation:true, noiseSuppression:true, autoGainControl:true, channelCount:2, sampleRate:48000}
    });
    if(!call){ s.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop()); return; }
    call.mediaStream = s;
    if(video){ const v=$('#csVideo'); v.srcObject=s; v.classList.add('on'); v.play().catch(()=>{}); }
    if(call.muted) s.getAudioTracks().forEach(t=> t.enabled=false);
  }catch(e){ if(video) toast((e&&e.name==='NotAllowedError')?'Camera/mic permission denied':'Camera did not open'); }
}
function toggleMute(){ if(rtc){ rtc.muted=!rtc.muted; $('#csMute').classList.toggle('active', rtc.muted); if(rtc.localStream) rtc.localStream.getAudioTracks().forEach(t=> t.enabled=!rtc.muted); toast(rtc.muted?'Mute ON':'Mute OFF'); return; } if(!call) return; call.muted=!call.muted; $('#csMute').classList.toggle('active', call.muted); if(call.mediaStream) call.mediaStream.getAudioTracks().forEach(t=> t.enabled=!call.muted); toast(call.muted?'Mute ON':'Mute OFF'); }
function toggleCallCam(){
  if(rtc){
    const hasVideo = rtc.localStream && rtc.localStream.getVideoTracks().length>0;
    if(!hasVideo){ toast('This is a voice call'); return; }
    rtc.video=!rtc.video;
    rtc.localStream.getVideoTracks().forEach(t=> t.enabled=rtc.video);
    $('#csCam').classList.toggle('active', rtc.video);
    $('#callScreen').classList.toggle('video', rtc.video);
    const lv=$('#csVideo'); if(lv){ lv.classList.toggle('on', rtc.video); lv.classList.toggle('pip', rtc.video); }
    const rv=$('#csRemote'); if(rv) rv.classList.toggle('on', rtc.video);
    return;
  }
  if(!call) return; call.video=!call.video;
  $('#csCam').classList.toggle('active', call.video); $('#callScreen').classList.toggle('video', call.video);
  if(call.mediaStream && call.mediaStream.getVideoTracks().length){ call.mediaStream.getVideoTracks().forEach(t=> t.enabled=call.video); $('#csVideo').classList.toggle('on', call.video); }
  else if(call.video){ startCallMedia(true); }
}
function toggleSpk(){ if(rtc){ rtc.spk=!rtc.spk; $('#csSpk').classList.toggle('active', rtc.spk); toast(rtc.spk?'Speaker ON':'Speaker OFF'); return; } if(!call) return; call.spk=!call.spk; $('#csSpk').classList.toggle('active', call.spk); toast(call.spk?'Speaker ON':'Speaker OFF'); }
function endCall(){
  if(rtc){ try{ fb.db.collection('calls').doc(rtc.id).set({ state:'ended', updatedAt: Date.now() }, {merge:true}); }catch(e){} rtcCleanup(); return; }
  if(!call) return;
  stopRingtone();
  const c = call;
  clearTimeout(c.connectTimer); clearInterval(c.timer);
  if(c.mediaStream) c.mediaStream.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
  const dur = c.connected ? Math.floor((Date.now()-c.started)/1000) : 0;
  logCall(c.name, 'out', c.video, dur);
  call = null;
  const v=$('#csVideo'); v.classList.remove('on'); v.srcObject=null;
  $('#callScreen').classList.remove('show');
  renderMain();
  toast(c.connected ? 'Call ended · '+fmtDur(dur) : 'Call ended · no answer');
}
function logCall(name, dir, video, dur){
  state.calls = state.calls || [];
  state.calls.unshift({id:'k'+now(), name, dir, video:!!video, ts:now(), dur:Math.max(0,Math.round(dur))});
  if(state.calls.length>60) state.calls.pop();
  save();
}
function callRowActions(id){
  const k=(state.calls||[]).find(x=>x.id===id); if(!k) return;
  openActionSheet(k.name, [
    {label:'Call back', fn:()=>{ closeActionSheet(); startCall(k.name, k.video); }},
    {label:'Delete entry', danger:true, fn:()=>{ state.calls=state.calls.filter(x=>x.id!==id); save(); renderMain(); closeActionSheet(); toast('Entry deleted'); }}
  ]);
}
function openNewCallSheet(){
  const body=$('#callPickBody');
  body.innerHTML = `<div class="section-label">Contacts</div>` + (CONTACTS.length ? CONTACTS.map(n=>`
    <div class="chat-item" data-callnew="${esc(n)}">
      <div class="avatar" style="background:${AV(n)}">${INI(n)}</div>
      <div class="chat-main"><div class="chat-top"><span class="chat-name">${esc(n)}</span></div><div class="chat-preview">Tap to call</div></div>
    </div>`).join('') : `<div class="set-note">No contacts yet.</div>`);
  $('#callPickSheet').style.display='flex';
}

/* ---------- Ringtone (Web Audio) — loud ---------- */
let audioCtx=null, ringTimer=null, ringNodes=[], ringMaster=null, vibTimer=null;
function ensureAudio(){
  try{
    if(!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if(audioCtx.state==='suspended') audioCtx.resume().catch(()=>{});
    if(!ringMaster){
      ringMaster = audioCtx.createGain();
      ringMaster.gain.value = 1.0;
      const comp = audioCtx.createDynamicsCompressor();
      comp.threshold.value = -6; comp.knee.value = 8; comp.ratio.value = 16; comp.attack.value = 0.003; comp.release.value = 0.25;
      ringMaster.connect(comp); comp.connect(audioCtx.destination);
    }
  }catch(e){ audioCtx=null; }
  return audioCtx;
}
/* unlock audio on the first user gesture (mobile autoplay policy) */
['pointerdown','touchstart','keydown'].forEach(ev=>{
  document.addEventListener(ev, ()=>{ try{ ensureAudio(); }catch(e){} }, {passive:true});
});
/* loud classic "ring": two tones with a fast warble, ~1.5s on */
function ringBurst(){
  const ctx = ensureAudio(); if(!ctx) return;
  const t = ctx.currentTime, dur = 1.5, dest = ringMaster || ctx.destination;
  const g = ctx.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.95, t+0.02);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.95, t+dur-0.06);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t+dur);
  const lfo = ctx.createOscillator(), lg = ctx.createGain();
  lfo.type='sine'; lfo.frequency.value=18; lg.gain.value=55;
  lfo.connect(lg);
  [[640,'sine'],[760,'triangle'],[640,'square']].forEach(pair=>{
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    osc.type=pair[1]; osc.frequency.value=pair[0];
    lg.connect(osc.frequency);
    osc.connect(g); osc.start(t); osc.stop(t+dur+0.03);
    ringNodes.push(osc);
  });
  g.connect(dest);
  lfo.start(t); lfo.stop(t+dur+0.03); ringNodes.push(lfo);
}
function startRingtone(withVibrate){
  if(state.settings && state.settings.ringtone===false) return;
  stopRingtone();
  ensureAudio();
  ringBurst();
  ringTimer = setInterval(ringBurst, 2400);
  if(withVibrate && navigator.vibrate){
    const buzz = ()=>{ try{ navigator.vibrate([700,300,700,500]); }catch(e){} };
    buzz(); vibTimer = setInterval(buzz, 2400);
  }
}
function stopRingtone(){
  if(ringTimer){ clearInterval(ringTimer); ringTimer=null; }
  if(vibTimer){ clearInterval(vibTimer); vibTimer=null; }
  try{ if(navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(0); }catch(e){}
  ringNodes.forEach(n=>{ try{ n.stop(); }catch(e){} });
  ringNodes = [];
}

/* ---------- Emoji picker ---------- */
