let epCat = Object.keys(EMOJI)[0];
function renderEmojiPanel(){
  const tabs = $('#epTabs'), grid = $('#epGrid'); if(!tabs || !grid) return;
  tabs.innerHTML = Object.keys(EMOJI).map(c=>`<button class="${c===epCat?'on':''}" data-epcat="${c}">${c}</button>`).join('');
  grid.innerHTML = EMOJI[epCat].map(e=>`<button class="ep-e" data-emoji="${e}">${e}</button>`).join('');
  grid.scrollTop = 0;
}
function toggleEmojiPanel(force){
  const p = $('#emojiPanel'); if(!p) return;
  const show = force!==undefined ? force : !p.classList.contains('show');
  p.classList.toggle('show', show);
  if(show){ toggleAttachMenu(false); renderEmojiPanel(); }
}

/* ---------- Forward ---------- */
let fwdMsg = null, snackTimer = null;
function showSnack(text, actionLabel, actionFn){
  const s = $('#snackbar'); if(!s) return;
  $('#snackText').textContent = text;
  const b = $('#snackAction');
  if(actionLabel){ b.textContent = actionLabel; b.style.display='inline-block'; b.onclick = ()=>{ hideSnack(); if(actionFn) actionFn(); }; }
  else { b.style.display='none'; b.onclick = null; }
  s.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(snackTimer); snackTimer = setTimeout(hideSnack, 5000);
}
function hideSnack(){ const s=$('#snackbar'); if(s) s.classList.remove('show'); clearTimeout(snackTimer); snackTimer=null; }
function fwdPreviewHTML(m){
  if(!m) return '';
  if(m.kind==='image') return `<div class="fwd-preview"><img src="${m.thumb||m.url||m.data}" alt="photo" onerror="this.style.display='none'"><div class="fw-tx"><div class="lbl">Forwarding</div><div class="bd">Photo</div></div></div>`;
  const map = {video:['🎥','Video'], file:['📄',(m.name||'Document')], voice:['🎤','Voice message'], location:['📍',(m.live?'Live location':'Location')]};
  if(m.kind && map[m.kind]) return `<div class="fwd-preview"><div class="fw-ic">${map[m.kind][0]}</div><div class="fw-tx"><div class="lbl">Forwarding</div><div class="bd">${esc(map[m.kind][1])}</div></div></div>`;
  return `<div class="fwd-preview"><div class="fw-ic">💬</div><div class="fw-tx"><div class="lbl">Forwarding</div><div class="bd">${esc(m.text||'')}</div></div></div>`;
}
let fwdMsgs = [], fwdSel = new Set();
function openForwardSheet(mOrArr){
  fwdMsgs = Array.isArray(mOrArr) ? mOrArr.slice() : (mOrArr?[mOrArr]:[]);
  if(!fwdMsgs.length) return;
  fwdSel = new Set();
  renderFwdList('');
  const sh=document.getElementById('fwdSheet'); if(sh) sh.style.display='flex';
}
function renderFwdList(q){
  const body=document.getElementById('fwdBody'); if(!body) return;
  const qq=(q||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const chats=state.chats.filter(c=>!c.archived && (!qq || (c.name||'').toLowerCase().indexOf(qq)>=0));
  body.innerHTML =
    '<div class="fwd-search"><input id="fwdSearch" placeholder="Search name" value="'+esc(q||'')+'"></div>'
    + (fwdMsgs.length===1 ? fwdPreviewHTML(fwdMsgs[0])
       : '<div class="fwd-preview"><div class="fw-ic">📨</div><div class="fw-tx"><div class="lbl">Forwarding</div><div class="bd">'+fwdMsgs.length+' messages</div></div></div>')
    + '<div class="section-label">Forward to</div>'
    + (chats.length ? chats.map(c=>'<div class="fwd-row" data-fwd="'+c.id+'">'
        + '<div class="avatar" style="background:'+AV(c.name)+'">'+INI(c.name)+'</div>'
        + '<div class="chat-main"><div class="chat-name">'+esc(c.name)+'</div><div class="chat-preview">'+(c.isGroup?'Group chat':'Chat')+'</div></div>'
        + '<span class="fwd-check '+(fwdSel.has(String(c.id))?'on':'')+'">✓</span></div>').join('')
       : '<div class="set-note" style="padding:14px 16px">No chats found.</div>');
  const si=document.getElementById('fwdSearch');
  if(si){ si.oninput=()=>{ const v=si.value, pos=v.length; renderFwdList(v); const s2=document.getElementById('fwdSearch'); if(s2){ s2.focus(); s2.setSelectionRange(pos,pos); } }; }
  updateFwdSend();
}
function toggleFwd(id){
  id=String(id);
  if(fwdSel.has(id)) fwdSel.delete(id); else fwdSel.add(id);
  const row=document.querySelector('.fwd-row[data-fwd="'+id+'"]');
  if(row){ const ch=row.querySelector('.fwd-check'); if(ch) ch.classList.toggle('on', fwdSel.has(id)); }
  updateFwdSend();
}
function updateFwdSend(){ const b=document.getElementById('fwdSend'); if(b) b.classList.toggle('show', fwdSel.size>0); }
function forwardOne(chatId, m){
  const target=state.chats.find(x=>x.id===chatId); if(!target||!m) return;
  let copy; try{ copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(m)); }catch(e){ copy=Object.assign({},m); }
  copy.id=now()+Math.random(); copy.from='me'; copy.ts=now(); copy.status='sent'; copy.sender=null; copy.forwarded=true; copy.starred=false;
  if(copy.kind==='location'){ copy.live=false; copy.expiresAt=null; copy.me=null; copy.them=null; copy.hist=null; copy.acc=null; }
  if(target.cloud){
    cloudSend(target.id, { kind:copy.kind, text:copy.text, data:copy.data, name:copy.name, size:copy.size, mime:copy.mime, dur:copy.dur, forwarded:true, lat:copy.lat, lng:copy.lng, acc:copy.acc, url:copy.url, thumb:copy.thumb, iv:copy.iv });
  } else {
    target.msgs.push(copy); save();
    if(activeChatId===chatId) renderMessages();
    renderMain();
    setTimeout(()=>{ copy.status='delivered'; save(); if(activeChatId===chatId) renderMessages(); renderMain(); }, 600);
    setTimeout(()=>{ copy.status='read'; save(); if(activeChatId===chatId) renderMessages(); renderMain(); }, 1400);
  }
}
function doForwardMulti(){
  if(!fwdSel.size){ toast('Select at least one chat'); return; }
  const ids=[...fwdSel];
  ids.forEach(cid=> fwdMsgs.forEach(m=> forwardOne(cid, m)));
  const sh=document.getElementById('fwdSheet'); if(sh) sh.style.display='none';
  exitSelect();
  const nm = ids.length===1 ? ((state.chats.find(x=>x.id===ids[0])||{}).name||'chat') : (ids.length+' chats');
  toast('Forwarded to '+nm);
  if(ids.length===1){ showSnack('Forwarded to '+nm, 'View', ()=>openChat(ids[0])); }
}

/* ---------- Presence (online / offline / last seen) ---------- */
function ensurePresence(){ state.presence = state.presence || {}; }
function isOnline(name){ const p = state.presence && state.presence[name]; return !!(p && p.online); }
function lastSeenText(ts){
  const d=new Date(ts), n=new Date(), y=new Date(n.getTime()-86400000);
  const t = d.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',hour12:true});
  if(d.toDateString()===n.toDateString()) return 'today at '+t;
  if(d.toDateString()===y.toDateString()) return 'yesterday at '+t;
  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN',{day:'numeric',month:'short'})+' at '+t;
}
function statusText(name){
  if(isOnline(name)) return 'online';
  if(state.settings && state.settings.lastSeen===false) return 'last seen recently';
  const p = state.presence && state.presence[name];
  if(p && p.lastSeen) return 'last seen '+lastSeenText(p.lastSeen);
  return 'offline';
}
/* A cloud peer counts as online only if they are flagged online AND their heartbeat is fresh.
   This prevents a stale "online" (e.g. after an app crash) from sticking forever. */
const PRESENCE_FRESH_MS = 80000;
function peerIsOnline(c){
  if(!c) return false;
  if(!c.cloud) return isOnline(c.name);
  if(!c.peerOnline) return false;
  return !!(c.peerLastSeen && (Date.now() - c.peerLastSeen) < PRESENCE_FRESH_MS);
}
function peerStatusText(c){
  if(!c) return 'offline';
  if(!c.cloud) return c.isGroup ? ((c.members?c.members.length:0)+' members') : statusText(c.name);
  if(peerIsOnline(c)) return 'online';
  if(c.peerLastSeen) return 'last seen '+lastSeenText(c.peerLastSeen);
  return 'offline';
}
function refreshPresenceUI(){
  document.querySelectorAll('#mainScroll [data-chat]').forEach(row=>{
    const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===row.dataset.chat); if(!c) return;
    const av = row.querySelector('.avatar'); if(!av) return;
    const has = av.querySelector('.dot'), want = peerIsOnline(c);
    if(want && !has){ const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='dot'; av.appendChild(d); }
    else if(!want && has){ has.remove(); }
  });
}
function refreshChatHeaderPresence(){
  if(!activeChatId) return;
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); if(!c) return;
  const st = $('#chatStatus'); if(st) st.textContent = peerStatusText(c);
  const av = $('#chatAvatar');
  if(av){
    const has = av.querySelector('.dot'), want = !c.isGroup && peerIsOnline(c);
    if(want && !has){ const d=document.createElement('span'); d.className='dot'; av.appendChild(d); }
    else if(!want && has){ has.remove(); }
  }
}
/* ---------- Our own presence (real) ---------- */
/* Online only while the tab is actually visible; going offline on hide/close. */
function setPresenceVisible(){ setCloudPresence(document.visibilityState === 'visible'); }
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', setPresenceVisible);
window.addEventListener('pagehide', ()=> setCloudPresence(false));
window.addEventListener('beforeunload', ()=> setCloudPresence(false));
/* heartbeat keeps our lastSeen fresh so peers can trust our "online" */
setInterval(()=>{ if(document.visibilityState==='visible') setCloudPresence(true); }, 30000);
/* re-evaluate peer freshness so a stale "online" becomes "last seen" */
setInterval(()=>{ refreshPresenceUI(); refreshChatHeaderPresence(); }, 20000);

/* ---------- End-to-end encryption (E2EE) ----------
   Each device makes an ECDH (P-256) key pair. The public key is published to
   Firestore (users/{uid}.pubKey); the PRIVATE key never leaves this device.
   Both sides derive the same AES-256-GCM key from (my private key + their public
   key), so the server only ever stores ciphertext. */
const E2E = { ready:false, priv:null, pub:null };
const e2eSharedCache = {};
const e2ePeerPubCache = {};
function bufToB64(buf){ const b=new Uint8Array(buf); let s=''; for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++) s+=String.fromCharCode(b[i]); return btoa(s); }
function b64ToBuf(str){ const bin=atob(str); const b=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) b[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); return b; }
async function e2eInit(uid){
  try{
    if(!(window.crypto && crypto.subtle)) return false;
    /* The private key / identity may have changed (e.g. logout->login without a
       reload). Drop any cached shared keys, else a stale one would corrupt
       encryption and decryption and show "Unable to decrypt". */
    for(const k in e2eSharedCache) delete e2eSharedCache[k];
    for(const k in e2ePeerPubCache) delete e2ePeerPubCache[k];
    let saved=null; try{ saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pluto_e2e_'+uid)||'null'); }catch(e){}
    // 1) same key on every device -> prefer the cloud copy (keys/{uid}, readable only by the owner)
    try{
      const kd = await fb.db.collection('keys').doc(uid).get();
      const kk = kd && kd.data();
      if(kk && kk.priv && kk.pub){
        E2E.priv = await crypto.subtle.importKey('jwk', kk.priv, {name:'ECDH',namedCurve:'P-256'}, false, ['deriveKey','deriveBits']);
        E2E.pub = kk.pub; E2E.ready = true;
        try{ localStorage.setItem('pluto_e2e_'+uid, JSON.stringify({priv:kk.priv, pub:kk.pub})); }catch(e){}
        try{ await fb.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({pubKey:kk.pub}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
        return true;
      }
    }catch(e){}
    // 2) this device already has a key -> use it and publish it so the other devices pick the same one
    if(saved && saved.priv && saved.pub){
      E2E.priv = await crypto.subtle.importKey('jwk', saved.priv, {name:'ECDH',namedCurve:'P-256'}, false, ['deriveKey','deriveBits']);
      E2E.pub = saved.pub; E2E.ready = true;
      try{ await fb.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({pubKey:saved.pub}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
      try{ await fb.db.collection('keys').doc(uid).set({priv:saved.priv, pub:saved.pub}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
      return true;
    }
    const kp = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({name:'ECDH',namedCurve:'P-256'}, true, ['deriveKey','deriveBits']);
    const privJwk = await crypto.subtle.exportKey('jwk', kp.privateKey);
    const pubRaw  = await crypto.subtle.exportKey('raw', kp.publicKey);
    const pubB64  = bufToB64(pubRaw);
    try{ localStorage.setItem('pluto_e2e_'+uid, JSON.stringify({priv:privJwk, pub:pubB64})); }catch(e){}
    E2E.priv = kp.privateKey; E2E.pub = pubB64; E2E.ready = true;
    try{ await fb.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({pubKey:pubB64}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
    try{ await fb.db.collection('keys').doc(uid).set({priv:privJwk, pub:pubB64}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){}
    return true;
  }catch(e){ return false; }
}
async function e2eSharedKey(peerPubB64){
  const ck = (E2E.pub||'')+'|'+peerPubB64;   // include OUR key in the cache key
  if(e2eSharedCache[ck]) return e2eSharedCache[ck];
  const peerPub = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', b64ToBuf(peerPubB64), {name:'ECDH',namedCurve:'P-256'}, false, []);
  const key = await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'ECDH', public:peerPub}, E2E.priv, {name:'AES-GCM', length:256}, false, ['encrypt','decrypt']);
  e2eSharedCache[ck] = key; return key;
}
async function e2eGetPeerPub(peerUid, force){
  if(!peerUid) return null;
  const cached = e2ePeerPubCache[peerUid];
  if(!force && cached && cached.pub && (Date.now()-cached.ts) < 20000) return cached.pub;
  let pub=null;
  try{ const d = await fb.db.collection('users').doc(peerUid).get(); pub = (d.data()||{}).pubKey || null; }catch(e){}
  if(pub) e2ePeerPubCache[peerUid] = { pub, ts: Date.now() };   // refresh ~every 60s so a changed key is picked up
  return pub;
}
async function e2eEncrypt(peerPubB64, payload){
  const key = await e2eSharedKey(peerPubB64);
  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const ct = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({name:'AES-GCM', iv}, key, new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(payload)));
  return { enc: bufToB64(ct), iv: bufToB64(iv), alg:'ECDH-P256/AES-GCM' };
}
async function e2eDecrypt(peerPubB64, enc, iv){
  const key = await e2eSharedKey(peerPubB64);
  const pt = await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM', iv: b64ToBuf(iv)}, key, b64ToBuf(enc));
  return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(pt));
}
function applyPayload(m, payload){
  if(payload.text!=null) m.text = payload.text;
  if(payload.data!=null) m.data = payload.data;
  if(payload.name!=null) m.name = payload.name;
  if(payload.size!=null) m.size = payload.size;
  if(payload.mime!=null) m.mime = payload.mime;
  if(payload.dur!=null) m.dur = payload.dur;
  if(payload.sender!=null) m.sender = payload.sender;
  if(payload.lat!=null) m.lat = payload.lat;
  if(payload.lng!=null) m.lng = payload.lng;
  if(payload.acc!=null) m.acc = payload.acc;
  if(payload.live!=null) m.live = payload.live;
  if(payload.expiresAt!=null) m.expiresAt = payload.expiresAt;
  if(payload.real!=null) m.real = payload.real;
  if(payload.forwarded!=null) m.forwarded = payload.forwarded;
  if(payload.url!=null) m.url = payload.url;
  if(payload.thumb!=null) m.thumb = payload.thumb;
  if(payload.iv!=null) m.iv = payload.iv;
  m.encrypted = true;
}
function updateChatLock(c){
  const el = $('#chatLock'); if(!el) return;
  const on = !!(c && c.cloud && E2E.ready && c.peerPub);
  el.style.display = on ? 'inline' : 'none';
}
/* if our key isn't set up yet, keep trying whenever the app comes back to the foreground */
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', ()=>{ if(document.visibilityState==='visible' && fb.enabled && fb.uid && !E2E.ready){ e2eInit(fb.uid).catch(()=>{}); } });

/* ---------- Cloud chat (Firestore, real 2-user) ---------- */
let cloudUnsubChats = null, cloudUnsubMsgs = null, cloudUnsubPeer = null, cloudUnsubLive = null, cloudMsgsChatId = null;
function chatIdFor(a,b){ return [a,b].sort().join('_'); }
function previewOf(m){
  if(m.kind==='image') return '📷 Photo';
  if(m.kind==='video') return '🎥 Video';
  if(m.kind==='file') return '📄 '+(m.name||'Document');
  if(m.kind==='voice') return '🎤 Voice message';
  if(m.kind==='location') return '📍 Location';
  return m.text||'';
}
function stopCloudMsgs(){
  if(cloudUnsubMsgs){ try{cloudUnsubMsgs();}catch(e){} cloudUnsubMsgs=null; }
  if(cloudUnsubPeer){ try{cloudUnsubPeer();}catch(e){} cloudUnsubPeer=null; }
  if(cloudUnsubLive){ try{cloudUnsubLive();}catch(e){} cloudUnsubLive=null; }
  cloudMsgsChatId = null;
}
function stopCloudChats(){ if(cloudUnsubChats){ try{cloudUnsubChats();}catch(e){} cloudUnsubChats=null; } stopCloudMsgs(); state.chats=[]; }
function startCloudChats(){
  if(!fb.enabled || !fb.uid) return;
  if(cloudUnsubChats){ try{cloudUnsubChats();}catch(e){} cloudUnsubChats=null; }
  try{
    cloudUnsubChats = fb.db.collection('chats').where('members','array-contains', fb.uid).onSnapshot((snap)=>{
      const list = [];
      snap.forEach(doc=>{
        const d = doc.data()||{};
        const other = (d.members||[]).find(x=>x!==fb.uid) || '';
        const name = (d.names && d.names[other]) || 'Chat';
        list.push({ id: doc.id, name, cloud:true, peerUid: other, pinned:false, unread:0, msgs:[], lastMsg: d.lastMsg||null, peerOnline:false, peerLastSeen:null, liveLoc: d.liveLoc||null });
      });
      list.sort((a,b)=> ((b.lastMsg&&b.lastMsg.ts)||0) - ((a.lastMsg&&a.lastMsg.ts)||0));
      const prev = state.chats.filter(c=>c.cloud);
      list.forEach(nc=>{ const old = prev.find(o=>o.id===nc.id); if(old){ nc.msgs=old.msgs; nc.peerOnline=old.peerOnline; nc.peerLastSeen=old.peerLastSeen; nc.peerPub=old.peerPub; nc.live=old.live; nc.livePeer=old.livePeer; nc.pinned=old.pinned; nc.archived=old.archived; nc.unread=old.unread; nc._seenTs=old._seenTs; nc._notifTs=old._notifTs; } });
      state.chats = list;
      save();
      list.forEach(nc=>{ applyLiveLoc(nc, nc.liveLoc); });
      if(activeChatId){ const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===activeChatId); if(c) startCloudMsgs(c); else closeChat(); }
      renderMain();
    }, (err)=>{ toast('Could not load chats: '+((err&&err.message)||'')); });
  }catch(e){ toast('Chats listener fail: '+e.message); }
}
function startCloudMsgs(c){
  if(!fb.enabled || !c || !c.cloud) return;
  if(cloudUnsubMsgs && cloudMsgsChatId === c.id) return;   // already listening to this chat
  stopCloudMsgs();
  cloudMsgsChatId = c.id;
  if(c.peerUid){ e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid).then(pub=>{ const cur = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===c.id); if(cur) cur.peerPub = pub; updateChatLock(cur||c); }); }
  try{
    cloudUnsubMsgs = fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).collection('messages').orderBy('ts','asc').onSnapshot(async (snap)=>{
      const cur = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===c.id) || c;   // write to the object that is actually in state
      const msgs = [];
      snap.forEach(doc=>{
        const m = doc.data()||{};
        msgs.push({ id: doc.id, from:(m.from===fb.uid?'me':'them'), text:m.text||'', enc:m.enc||null, iv:m.iv||null, ts:m.ts||0, kind:m.kind, data:m.data, name:m.name, size:m.size, mime:m.mime, dur:m.dur, sender:m.sender, lat:m.lat, lng:m.lng, acc:m.acc, live:m.live, expiresAt:m.expiresAt, real:m.real, status:m.status, forwarded:m.forwarded, url:m.url, thumb:m.thumb, iv:m.iv });
      });
      let peerPub = await e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid);
      if(!peerPub) peerPub = cur.peerPub || c.peerPub;
      if(peerPub) cur.peerPub = peerPub;
      for(const m of msgs){
        if(!m.enc) continue;
        if(!peerPub){ m.text = '🔒 Encrypted message'; continue; }
        let payload = null;
        try{ payload = await e2eDecrypt(peerPub, m.enc, m.iv); }
        catch(e){
          /* the other device may have changed its key — refresh it once and retry */
          try{
            const fresh = await e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid, true);
            if(fresh && fresh !== peerPub){ peerPub = fresh; cur.peerPub = fresh; c.peerPub = fresh; payload = await e2eDecrypt(fresh, m.enc, m.iv); }
          }catch(_){}
        }
        if(payload && typeof payload==='object'){ applyPayload(m, payload); }
        else { m.text = '🔒 Unable to decrypt'; m.decryptFailed = true; }
      }
      /* mark the peer's messages delivered/read so the sender sees ticks */
      for(const doc of snap.docs){
        const mm = doc.data()||{};
        if(mm.from===fb.uid) continue;
        const want = (activeChatId===c.id) ? 'read' : 'delivered';
        if(mm.status!==want){ try{ doc.ref.set({status:want}, {merge:true}); }catch(e){} }
      }
      const _oldById = {}; (cur.msgs||[]).forEach(x=>{ _oldById[x.id]=x; });
      msgs.forEach(m=>{ const o=_oldById[m.id]; if(o && o.starred) m.starred=true; });
      const live = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===c.id) || cur;   // re-resolve after the awaits (chat list may have rebuilt)
      live.msgs = msgs;
      if(activeChatId!==c.id){
        const seen = live._seenTs || 0;
        const fresh = msgs.filter(m=>m.from==='them' && (m.ts||0) > seen);
        live.unread = fresh.length;
        const last = fresh[fresh.length-1];
        if(last && (last.ts||0) > (live._notifTs||0)){ live._notifTs = last.ts; if(state.settings.notifMessages!==false){ try{ sysNotify(live.name||'Pluto', previewOf(last)||'New message'); }catch(e){} } }
      }
      if(activeChatId===c.id){ renderMessages(); updateChatLock(live); }
      renderMain();
    }, (err)=>{ toast('Could not load messages: '+((err&&err.message)||'')); });
  }catch(e){}
  if(c.peerUid){
    try{
      cloudUnsubPeer = fb.db.collection('users').doc(c.peerUid).onSnapshot((doc)=>{
        const cur = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===c.id) || c;
        const d = doc.data()||{};
        cur.peerOnline = !!d.online;
        cur.peerLastSeen = (d.lastSeen && d.lastSeen.toMillis) ? d.lastSeen.toMillis() : (typeof d.lastSeen==='number' ? d.lastSeen : null);
        if(activeChatId===c.id){
          const st=$('#chatStatus'); if(st) st.textContent = peerStatusText(cur);
          const av=$('#chatAvatar'); if(av){ const has=av.querySelector('.dot'); if(peerIsOnline(cur) && !has){ const dd=document.createElement('span'); dd.className='dot'; av.appendChild(dd); } else if(!peerIsOnline(cur) && has){ has.remove(); } }
        }
        renderMain();
      }, ()=>{});
    }catch(e){}
  }
  if(c.peerUid){
    try{
      cloudUnsubLive = fb.db.collection('chats').doc(c.id).collection('live').doc(c.peerUid).onSnapshot((doc)=>{
        const cur = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===c.id) || c;
        const d = (doc && doc.exists) ? (doc.data()||{}) : null;
        if(d && d.lat!=null && (!d.exp || d.exp>now())){
          cur.livePeer = { lat:d.lat, lng:d.lng, acc:d.acc, ts:d.ts, exp:d.exp };
          if(cur.live) cur.live.them = { lat:d.lat, lng:d.lng };
          const m = (cur.msgs||[]).filter(x=>x.kind==='location' && x.live && x.from==='them').slice(-1)[0];
          if(m){ m.lat=d.lat; m.lng=d.lng; if(d.exp) m.expiresAt=d.exp; m.live = true; }
          syncLiveMsg(cur);
        } else {
          cur.livePeer = null;
        }
        if(activeChatId===cur.id){ renderMessages(); const ms=document.getElementById('mapScreen'); if(ms && ms.classList.contains('show')) drawMap(false); }
      }, ()=>{});
    }catch(e){}
  }
}
async function cloudSend(chatId, obj){
  if(!fb.enabled || !fb.uid){ toast('Not connected — message not sent'); return false; }
  const c = state.chats.find(x=>x.id===chatId);
  if(!c || !c.cloud){ toast('Chat not ready — message not sent'); return false; }
  let peerPub = await e2eGetPeerPub(c.peerUid);   // refreshed ~every 60s
  if(!peerPub) peerPub = c.peerPub;
  if(peerPub) c.peerPub = peerPub;
  let msg = { from: fb.uid, ts: Date.now(), status: 'sent' };
  if(E2E.ready && peerPub && obj.kind !== 'location'){
    try{
      const payload = {};
      ['text','data','name','size','mime','dur','sender','lat','lng','acc','live','expiresAt','real','forwarded','url','thumb','iv'].forEach(k=>{ if(obj[k]!==undefined) payload[k]=obj[k]; });
      const encd = await e2eEncrypt(peerPub, payload);
      msg = Object.assign(msg, { enc: encd.enc, iv: encd.iv, alg: encd.alg });
      if(obj.kind!=null) msg.kind = obj.kind;   // never write undefined (Firestore rejects undefined fields)
    }catch(e){ msg = Object.assign(msg, obj); }
  } else {
    msg = Object.assign(msg, obj);
    if(obj.text){
      if(!E2E.ready && !cloudSend._warned){ cloudSend._warned=true; toast('Encryption unavailable — open the app over HTTPS for end-to-end encryption'); }
      // (no per-message nag when the recipient has no key; see Settings > Security for status)
    }
  }
  const preview = msg.enc ? '🔒 Encrypted message' : previewOf(msg);
  fb.db.collection('chats').doc(chatId).collection('messages').add(msg)
    .then(()=>{ lastSend='cloud OK ✓'; fb.db.collection('chats').doc(chatId).set({ lastMsg:{ text: preview, ts: msg.ts, from: fb.uid }, updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }, {merge:true}); })
    .catch(e=>{ lastSend='cloud FAIL: '+((e&&e.message)||''); toast('Message not sent: '+((e&&e.message)||'')); });
  return true;
}
function openCloudNewChat(){
  $('#contactList').innerHTML = `<div class="set-form">
    <div class="field"><label>Mobile number or name of your friend</label><input id="friendQuery" type="text" placeholder="+91 98765 43210  or  name"></div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="startCloudChat">Start chat</button>
    <div class="set-note" style="padding:0">Your friend also needs a Pluto account — the same mobile number they signed up with.</div>
  </div>`;
  $('#newChatSheet').style.display='flex';
  const b=$('#startCloudChat'); if(b) b.onclick=()=>startCloudChatWith(($('#friendQuery').value||'').trim());
}
function mobileKeyOf(m){ const d=(m||'').replace(/\D/g,''); return d.length>10 ? d.slice(-10) : d; }
async function findUserByQuery(q){
  q = (q||'').trim();
  const digits = q.replace(/\D/g,'');
  const tryQ = async (field, val)=>{ try{ const s = await fb.db.collection('users').where(field,'==',val).limit(1).get(); return s.empty?null:s.docs[0]; }catch(e){ return null; } };
  const tryPrefix = async (field, val)=>{ try{ const s = await fb.db.collection('users').orderBy(field).startAt(val).endAt(val+'\uf8ff').limit(1).get(); return s.empty?null:s.docs[0]; }catch(e){ return null; } };
  if(digits.length >= 7){
    const mk = mobileKeyOf(q);
    let d = await tryQ('mobileKey', mk); if(d) return d;
    d = await tryQ('mobile', mk); if(d) return d;
    d = await tryQ('mobile', digits); if(d) return d;
    d = await tryQ('mobile', q); if(d) return d;
    return null;
  }
  if(q.includes('@')){ return await tryQ('email', q.toLowerCase()); }
  const ql = q.toLowerCase();
  let d = await tryQ('nameLower', ql); if(d) return d;      // case-insensitive exact
  d = await tryQ('name', q); if(d) return d;                // exact as typed
  d = await tryPrefix('nameLower', ql); if(d) return d;     // case-insensitive prefix
  d = await tryPrefix('name', q); if(d) return d;
  return null;
}
async function startCloudChatWith(query){
  if(!fb.enabled || !fb.uid){ toast('Please log in first'); return; }
  if(!query){ toast('Enter a mobile number or name'); return; }
  try{
    const otherDoc = await findUserByQuery(query);
    if(!otherDoc){ toast('No user found. Ask your friend to open this app once (cloud mode), and try their mobile number or exact name.'); return; }
    const otherUid = otherDoc.id;
    if(otherUid===fb.uid){ toast('This is you 🙂'); return; }
    const cid = chatIdFor(fb.uid, otherUid);
    const names = {}; names[fb.uid] = (state.user&&state.user.name)||'User'; names[otherUid] = (otherDoc.data()&&otherDoc.data().name)||'User';
    await fb.db.collection('chats').doc(cid).set({ members:[fb.uid, otherUid], names, updatedAt: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.serverTimestamp() }, {merge:true});
    $('#newChatSheet').style.display='none';
    toast('Chat ready!');
    setTimeout(()=>{ if(state.chats.find(x=>x.id===cid)) openChat(cid); }, 900);
  }catch(e){ toast('Could not create chat: '+((e&&e.message)||'')); }
}

/* ---------- Init ---------- */
document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t=>t.classList.toggle('active', t.dataset.tab===state.tab));
ensurePresence();
renderMain();
applySettings();
(function boot(){
  bootFirebase().then((ok)=>{
    const note = $('#authModeNote');
    if(ok && fb.auth){
      if(note) note.textContent = 'Cloud mode · your account is saved on Firebase';
      state.user = null; save(); showAuth();
      fb.auth.onAuthStateChanged(async (u)=>{
        if(u){ await afterCloudAuth(u); }
        else { if(state.user){ state.user=null; save(); } showAuth(); }
      });
    } else {
      if(note) note.textContent = 'Local mode · your account is saved on this phone only';
      if(state.user){ hideAuth(); } else { showAuth(); }
    }
  }).catch(()=>{ if(state.user){ hideAuth(); } else { showAuth(); } });
})();

try{
  const manifest = {
    name:'Pluto Messenger', short_name:'Pluto', start_url:'.', display:'standalone',
    background_color:'#0d7d74', theme_color:'#0d7d74',
    icons:[{ src:"data:image/svg+xml," + encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="512"><rect width="512" height="512" rx="112" fill="#0d7d74"/><circle cx="256" cy="264" r="92" fill="#ffffff"/><ellipse cx="256" cy="264" rx="168" ry="60" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="24" transform="rotate(-24 256 264)" opacity="0.92"/><circle cx="400" cy="160" r="24" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85"/></svg>'), sizes:'512x512', type:'image/svg+xml', purpose:'any' }]
  };
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(manifest)], {type:'application/json'});
  const link = document.createElement('link');
  link.rel='manifest'; link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  document.head.appendChild(link);
}catch(e){}

/* ---------- Splash screen: hide after 3 seconds ---------- */
setTimeout(function(){
  var sp = document.getElementById('splash');
  if(sp) sp.classList.add('hide');
  setTimeout(function(){ if(sp && sp.parentNode) sp.parentNode.removeChild(sp); }, 700);
}, 3000);
</script>
